sa: तमसा रहितं पुण्यमनामृष्टं रवेः करैः। क्षुत्तृट्शीतोष्णदोषैश्च वर्जितं शोकनाशनम्॥
en: It was free from darkness, it was holy, it was untouched by the solar rays, it was free from all the miseries, namely hunger and thirst, heat and cold; it destroyed all sorrows.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीद्धनाध्यक्षः शरण्यः शरणागतम्। मानहा भव शत्रूणां सुहृदां नन्दिवर्धनः॥
en: Thereupon seeing him crave his protection, the lord of wealth, capable of affording protection, said "be you the destroyer of the pride of (your) enemies and enhancer of the joy of (your) friends.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीन्महाराजः कृतशौचमहं नलम्। दमयन्त्या सहोपेतं कल्ये द्रष्टा सुखोषितम्॥
en: The great king said in reply: “Tomorrow I shall see Nala with Damayanti by his side, after he shall have sanctified himself (by bath and prayers). Let him dwell in peace this day."

sa: नार्या म्लेच्छन्ति भाषाभिर्मायया न चरन्त्युत। अजिह्ममशठं युद्धमेतत् सत्पुरुषव्रतम्॥
en: Those that are respectable do not use the Mleccha language, nor do they adopt deceitfulness in their behaviours. The act of honest men is to carry on a war without crookedness of cunning.

sa: अक्रोधनश्च राजेन्द्र सत्यशीलो दृढव्रतः। आत्मोपमश्च भूतेषु स तीर्थफलमश्नुते॥
en: O king of kings, he who is free from anger, who is truthful, who is firm in his vows and who considers all creatures as his own self, enjoys the fruits of Tirthas.

sa: सेव्यश्चोपासितव्यश्च मतो नः काक्षितश्चिरम्। अयं च देवकीपुत्रः प्राप्तोऽस्मानवलोककः॥
en: We consider you deserve all honour and adoration; and we have, for a long time, been desirous of seeing you. This son of Devaki too has come here to pay us a visit.

sa: तत आयव्ययौ दृष्ट्वा समौ सममतिर्द्विजः। सर्वथा प्राणिनां पीडामुपादानामन्यत॥
en: Having seen that his income and expenditure were the same, the Rishi who always saw both sides with equal eyes thought if he took any thing from him he would injure other creatures.

sa: ततो हृष्टमना जिष्णुाराचान् मर्मभेदिनः। व्यसृजच्छतधा राजन् मयूखानिव भास्करः॥
en: O king, thereupon Jishnu, (Arjuna) with a chcerful heart began to hurl thousands of arrows, (each) capable of piercing to the very heart, as the sun spreads his rays (all over the world).

sa: कर्मणां श्रुतपुण्यानां पापानां च फलोदयः। प्रभवश्चात्ययश्चैव देवगुह्यानि भाविनि॥
en: The fruits of the holy acts laid down in the Vedas as well as of sinful acts, the root and the destruction of actions, O fair lady, are mysteries even to the celestials,

sa: तं सर्वभावोपगता पतिशुश्रूषणे रता। साध्वाचारा सुचिर्दक्षा कुटुम्बस्य हितैषिणी॥
en: Her thoughts all turned towards her husband; and she was always engaged in serving her lord. She was virtuous and was skillful in good behaviours; and also was ever beneficent to her relatives.

sa: कर्णभीष्मकृपद्रोणैर्भविता तु महाहवः। त्वत्प्रसादान्महादेव जयेयं तान् यथा युधि॥
en: That weapon, with the help of which, O great god, I may through your grace obtain victory in the great battle that will be fought by me with Karna, Bhishma, Kripa and Drona,

sa: व्यनदज्जातमात्रो हि गोमायुरिव भारत। अन्तो नूनं कुलस्यास्य कुरवस्तन्निबोधत॥
en: For he (Duryodhana) cried repeatedly and dissonantly like a jackal when he was born. It is certain he will prove the destruction of our race. Take this (the words of Vidura) to heart.

sa: विषमुद्बन्धनं चैव शस्त्रमग्निप्रवेशनम्। करिष्ये न हि तानृद्धान् पुनर्द्रष्टुमिहोत्सहे॥
en: I shall either take poison or hang myself; (I shall) either enter a pyre or kill myself with my own weapon. I shall not be able to see (endure) their (the Pandavas') prosperity.

sa: स हि ब्रह्मास्त्रवित्प्राज्ञो महामायो महाबलः। करोत्यसंज्ञान् संग्रामे देवान्सवरुणानपि॥
en: Without doubt, the is skilled in the Brahma weapon, is potent in illusion and, is possessed of exceeding strength. In conflict, he deprive of consciousness even the celestials with Varuņa (at their head).

sa: शिखरे तस्य शैलस्य मध्यमेऽम्बुदसंनिभे॥ शकुनैरपि दुष्प्रापे टङ्कच्छिन्नचतुर्दिशि। त्रिंशद्योजनविस्तीर्णा शतयोजनमायता॥ स्वर्णप्राकारसंवीता हेमतोरणसंवृता। मया लङ्केति नगरी शक्याज्ञप्तेन निर्मिता ॥
en: On the midmost peak of that mountain resembling clouds, inaccessible even to the fowls of the air, all the four quarters have been hewn with bones.* If I am desired by you, I can construct the city of Lanka (there), having an area of thirty Yojanas, and measuring an hundred in length; surrounded with a golden wall and furnished with golden gateways. *Tanka-may also mean a hatchet or a sword.

sa: अहमप्यतिभीतास्मि नैव जानामि को ह्यहम्। वेद्मि राक्षसमेवैनं कामरूपिणमागतम्॥
en: And, furthermore, I am very much frightened, nor know I who that one is. I take him to be a Rākşasa, who has come here through his capacity to put on any shape.

sa: अशास्त्रविदुषां तेषां कार्यं नाभिहितं वचः। अर्थशास्त्रानभिज्ञानां विपुलां श्रियमिच्छताम्॥
en: Albeit uttered heedfully, the speech of those that are ignorant of learning and the knowledge of the sense of things, and who are intent upon attaining abounding affluence, should not be acted upon.

sa: ललस्व मयि विस्रब्धा धृष्टमाज्ञापयस्व च। मत्प्रासादाल्ललन्त्याश्च ललतां बान्धवस्तव॥
en: Do you confiding in me, ask for your wishedfor objects and do you command me like to an unmannerly damsel. You shall, by asking favours from me, satisfy the desires of your friends.

sa: अवलिप्तासि सुश्रोणि यस्यास्ते मतिरीदृशी। वृद्वानां मृगशावाक्षि भ्राजते पुण्यसंचयः॥
en: O you of sharply hips, in as much as such is your intent, you must be very proud. O you having the eyes of young antelope, accumulation of religious merit suits old people.

sa: बिभीषणगृहीतौ तु वधार्य राक्षसेश्वर॥ दृष्ट्वा धर्मात्मना मुक्तौ रामेणामिततेजसा।
en: O lord of Rākşasas, having been taken by Vibhīşaņa for the purpose of being slain, we came to be seen by the righteous-souled Rāma of immeasurable energy, and (finally) were liberated (by him).

sa: रौक्मेषु च विशालेषु भाजनेष्वप्यभक्षितान्। ददर्श कपिशार्दूलो मयूरान् कुक्कुटांस्तथा॥ वराहवाध्रीणसकान् दधिसौवर्चलायुतान्। शल्यान् मृगमयूरांश्च हनुमानन्ववैक्षत॥ कृकलान् विविधांश्छागाञ्छशकानर्धभक्षितान्। महिषानेकशल्यांश्च मेषांश्च कृतनिष्ठितान्॥ लेह्यानुच्चावचान् पेयान् भोज्यान्युच्चावचानि च। तथाम्ललवणोत्तंसैविविधै रागखाण्डवैः॥
en: In that place set apart for drinking, he saw heaps of the flesh of buffaloes, deer, and boars, arranged separately, And that tiger-like monkey saw in capacious golden vessels flesh of fowls and peacocks, which remained (after the repast). And Hanumãn saw the flesh of boars, and Vádhrinasas Salyas, deer and peacocks, seasoned with curds and Sauvarcala, and Krkalas, and goats of various kinds, flesh of hare half-fed-Ekasalyas, and buffaloes, all chopped and dressed; and lickable and drinkable viands sharp and mild; and edibles sharp and mild; and Rägakhāndavas# containing sugar and acid, capable of improving a vicious palate.

sa: प्रशान्तपीडाबहुलो विनष्टारिः प्रहर्षवान्। बभूव लोकः पतिते राक्षसेन्द्रसुते तदा॥
en: The mighty-armed (Indrajit) was utterly shorn of life. And on the son of the Raksasa-chief falling, the world, having its foe slain, with its huge affliction gone off, experienced the height of joy.

sa: ते सुवेलस्य शैलस्य समीपे रामलक्ष्मणौ। प्रच्छन्ना ददृशुर्गत्वा ससुग्रीवविभीषणौ॥
en: And repairing secretly to the vicinity of the mountain bordering on the fair shore,* they saw Rāma and Lakşmaņa with Sugrīva and Vibhís ana. *Suvelasya Säilasya may also mean, of the mount Suvela.

sa: विभीषण त्वया वत्स धर्मसंहितबुद्धिना॥ पतितुष्टोऽस्मि धर्मात्मन्वरं वरय सुव्रत।
en: O Vibhisana, gratified have I been by you, whose intelligence is established in righteousness. Therefore, my child, O righteoussouled one, O you of excellent vows, ask for the boon that you would have.

sa: स तं शिरस्युपाघ्राय लक्ष्मणं कीर्तिवर्धनम्। लज्जमानं बलात्स्नेहादङ्कमारोप्य वीर्यवान्॥ उपवेश्य तमुत्सङ्गे परिष्वज्यावपीडितम्। धातर लक्ष्मण स्निग्धं पुनः पुनरुदैक्षत॥
en: Then smelling the head of the bashful Laks miana, enhancer of fame, (Rāma) endowed with prowess, from affection forcibly hugged him into his lap. And making him seat on his lap, and overpowering him with embraces,* (Rama) again and again tenderly eyed his brother, Lakş imana. * Aapiritam-fac) pained. Rāmānaya says this epithet refers to Laksmana's having been wounded in the encounter. I differ from him.

sa: मम हेतोरनार्याया अनघः पार्थिवात्मजः। रामः सागरमुत्तीर्य वीर्यवान्गोष्पदे हतः॥
en: And for the sake of me, abject that I am, that sinless son of the king, Rāma, possessed of prowess, having crossed the ocean, has been slain in the footprint of a cow.

sa: शत्रोः प्रख्यातवीर्यस्य रञ्जनीयस्य विक्रमैः। पश्यतो युद्धलुब्धोऽहं कृतः कापुरुषस्त्वया।६।।
en: In the very sight of an enemy of renowned prowess, and one capable of being gratified with valorous deeds, have you made me, burning for battle, look as if I were a coward.

sa: तं तथा समतिक्रान्तं नातिचक्राम राघवः। तमुद्धतममित्रघ्नो रामो नदनदीपतिम्॥
en: Seeing the elated Ocean-lord of streams and rivers, thus overpass his bounds, that destroyer of enemies, Raghu's son, Rāma, was not moved.* *Naticakrāma may also mean, (Rama) did not discharge any more arrows.

sa: यस्य वाजेषु पवनः फले पावकभास्करौ। शरीरमाकाशमयं गौरवे मेरुमन्दरौ॥
en: In its wings there is wind, in its head there is fire and the Sun, in its body there is the sky and in its weight there are the Chill) Meru and Mandara.

sa: एकाक्षीमेककर्णां च कर्णप्रावरणां तथा। गोकर्णी हस्तिकर्णी च लम्बकर्णीमकर्णिकाम्॥ हस्तिपद्यश्वपद्यौ च गोपदीं पादचूलिकाम्। एकाक्षीमेकपादी च पृथुपादीमपादिकाम्॥ अतिमात्रशिरोग्रीवामतिमात्रकुचोदरीम्। अतिमात्रस्यनेत्रां च दीर्घजिह्वानखामपि॥ अनासिकां सिंहमुखीं गोमुखीं सुकरीमुखीम्। यथा मद्वशगा सीता क्षिप्रं भवति जानकी॥ तथा कुरुत राक्षस्यः सर्वाः क्षिप्रं समेत्य वा। प्रतिलोमानुलोमैश्च सामदानादिभेदनैः॥ आवर्जयत वैदेहीं दण्डस्योद्यमनेन च।
en: And among those Rākṣasīs, some had huge ears, some had ears like those of kine, some had ears as long as arms, some had long ears and others were without any. And some had legs like those of an elephant; some had like those of a cow and some had legs covered with hairs. And some had one eye, some had one leg, some had capacious legs and some were without any. And some had huge heads and necks and some had breast and belly beyond proportions and some had faces and eyes above human size. Some had huge tongues and nails. And some were without noses. And some had leonine faces, some had faces like those of kine and some had those of boars. And casting his look towards such Raksasis, he said-You Raksasis, do youall endeavour to bring Sītā, the daughter of Janaka, under my control. By good or ba

sa: तामनुव्याहरच्छक्तिमापतन्ती स राघवः। स्वस्त्यस्तु लक्ष्मणायेति मोघा भव हतोद्यमा॥
en: Thereat as the dart descended, Raghava addressed it, saying-peace be to Laksmana! Be you frustrated; and let your energy go out of you. *i.e. as Rāmānuja remarks, addressed the deity presiding over it.

sa: एवं दोषो महानत्र प्रपन्नानामरक्षणे। अस्वयं चायशस्यं च बलवीर्यविनाशनम्॥
en: So great is the sin in not affording shelter to those who seek for it; it stands in the way of going to heaven, brings in calumny and destroys the strength and prowess.

sa: शूरमञ्जलिपातेन भीरुं भेदेन भेदयेत्। लुब्धमर्थप्रदानेन समं तुल्येन विग्रहः॥
en: A king should win over a hero by clasping his hands, a coward by terrorising him, and a covetous man by presents of money, and with an equal he should wage war carefully.

sa: ततः शरभसंत्रस्ताः सर्वे मृगगणास्तदा।॥ दिशः सम्प्राद्रवन् राजन् भयाज्जीवितकाक्षिणः।
en: All the animals then that lived in the neighbourhood were stricken with fear of that Sharabha. Their fear and the desire of saving their lives made them all fly away from that forest.

sa: बहुलत्वाश्च नोक्ता ये विविधा देवतागणाः। ते कुमाराभिषेकार्थं समाजग्मुस्ततस्ततः॥
en: I do not mention the various other gods that came there lest the list be a heavy one. All of them came to that ceremony for investing Kartikeya with the dignity of generalissimo.

sa: स चेन्ममार संजय चतुर्भद्रतरस्त्वया। पुत्रात् पुण्यतरश्चैव मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः॥
en: When he, O Srinjaya, who was superior to you in the four principal accomplishments and who was purer than your son, met with death, do not grieve for your son who is dead.

sa: ततः प्रभातसमये विकृतः कृष्णपिङ्गलः॥ स्थूलस्फिग् विकृतो रूक्षः श्वयूथपरिवारितः। शंकुकर्णो महावक्त्रो मलिनो घोरदर्शनः॥ परिघो नाम चाण्डाल: शस्त्रपाणिरदृश्यत।
en: When the dawn set in, the Chandala, whose name was Parigha, came there. His appearance was terrible. His hair was black and tawny. His hips were huge and his look was very fierce. Of a large mouth extending from ear to ear, and highly filthy, his ears were very long. man Armed with weapons and accompanied by a pack of dogs, the grim-visaged man came there.

sa: न विश्वसेदविश्वस्ते विश्वस्ते नातिविश्वसेत्॥ विश्वासाद् भयमुत्पन्नमपि मूलानि कृन्तति।
en: One should not trust a person undeserving of truth, nor should one trust too much a person worthy of trust. The anger from blind confidence is such that it cuts the very roots.

sa: रामादुपात्तेन महामहिम्ना ह्याथर्वणेनारिविनाशनेन। तदर्जुनास्त्रं व्यधमद् दहन्तं कर्णस्तु बाणैर्निशितैर्महात्मा॥
en: He then, with that mighty weapon he had received from Rama, which was vested with the Atharvan rite, worsted that firy weapon of Arjuna and also struck Partha with many other sharp arrows.

sa: स चेन्ममार संजय चतुर्भद्रतरस्त्वया। पुत्रात् पुण्यतरश्चैव मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः॥
en: When he, O Srinjaya, who was superior to you in the four principal attributes and who was purer than your son, met with death, do not grieve for your son who is dead.

sa: दुष्टामात्यसहायस्य च्युतमन्त्रस्य सर्वतः। राज्यात् प्रच्यवमानस्य गतिमभ्यामपश्यतः॥ परचक्राभियातस्य परराष्ट्राणि मृद्गतः। विग्रहे वर्तमानस्य दुर्बलस्य वलीयसा॥ असंविहितराष्ट्रस्य देशकालावजानतः। अप्राप्यं च भवेत् सान्त्वंभेदो वाप्यतिपीडनात्। जीवितं त्वर्थहेतुर्वा तत्र किं सुकृतं भवेत्॥
en: Again how should he behave hiinself when he is surrounded by wicked ministers, when his counsels are all divulged, when he does not find his way clearly before him, when he attacks another kingdom, when he is engaged in grinding a hostile kingdom, and when though weak he is at war with a powerful king? How should a king act whose affairs are iilmanaged and who disregards the requirements of place and time, who is unable, for his oppressions, to bring about peace and create disunion among his enemies? Should he try to acquire wealth by foul means or should he sacrifice his life without seeking wealth?

sa: हीनादादेयमादौ स्यात् समानात् तदनन्तरम्। असम्भवे वाऽऽदीत विशिष्टादपि धार्मिकात्॥
en: First of all one should steal from a degraded person. Failing such a person one may steal from one's equal. Failing an equal, one may steal from even a great and virtuous man.

sa: संस्तुवन्तो महादेवं भाः कुर्वाणा: सुवर्चसः॥ विवर्धयिषवो द्रौणेमहिमानं महात्मनः। जिज्ञासमानास्तत्तेजः सौप्तिकं च दिदृक्षवः॥ भीमोग्नपरिघालातशूलपटिशपाणयः। घोररूपा: समाजग्मुर्भूतसङ्घाः समन्ततः॥
en: Landing Mahadeva and spreading an effulgence all around, desirous of increasing the honor of Ashvatthaman and the glory of the great Hara, and wishing to ascertain the extent of Ashvatthaman's power, and desirous also of witnessing the destruction during the hour of sleep, armed with terrible and fierce bludgeons and fiery wheels and battle-axes, that host of strange beings, having terrible forins, came from all sides.

sa: स चेन्ममार संजय, चतुर्भद्रतरस्त्वया। पुत्रात् पुण्यतरश्चैव मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः॥
en: Indeed, O Srinjaya, when Shivi, who was far superior to your in four attributes and who was purer than your son met with death, do not grieve for your son, who is dead.

sa: महता रथघोषेण पृथिवीमनुनादयन्॥ एकच्छत्रां महीं चक्रे जैत्रेणैकरथेन यः।
en: Riding on a single car, which was crowned with success in every battle, king Shivi caused the whole Earth to resound with the rattle of his wheels and brought all kings under subjection.

sa: स चेन्ममार संजय चतुर्भद्रतरस्त्वया। पुत्रात् पुण्यतरश्चैव मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः॥
en: When he, O Srinjaya, who was superior to you in the four principal attributes and who was purer than your son, met with death, do not grieve for your son who is dead.

sa: चरणौ दह्यमानौ च नाचिन्तयदनिन्दिता। कुर्वाणा दुष्करं कर्म महर्षिप्रियकाम्यया॥
en: The beautiful girl did not at all mind her burning feet. Though it was a hard work, she did it from desire of doing good to the Rishi that had been her guest.

sa: स चेन्ममार संजय चतुर्भद्रतरस्त्वया॥ पुत्रात् पुण्यतरश्चैव मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः।
en: When O Srinjaya, this Brihadratha even, who was your superior in the four attributes and who was purer than your son, met with death, do not grieve for your son who is dead.

sa: स चेन्मार संजय चतुर्भद्रतरस्त्वया। पुत्रात् पुण्यतरश्चैव मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः॥
en: When he, O Srinjaya, who was superior to you in the four principal attributes and who was purer than your son, met with death, do not grieve for your son who is dead.

sa: भृगुर्ददावृषिभ्यस्तु दण्डं धर्मसमाहितम्। ऋषयो लोकपालेभ्यो लोकपालाः क्षुपाय च॥
en: Bhrigu gave that rod intended for the protection of righteousness to all the Rishis. The Rishis gave it to the Regents of the quarters, and the Regents made it over again to Kshupa.

sa: अपङ्का गर्तरहिता रथभूमिः प्रशस्यते। नीचगुमा महाकक्षा सोदका हस्तियोधिनाम्॥
en: A field which is free from mire and holes is best suited for car-warriors. A region which abounds with bushes and large trees and which is under water is suited for elephant warriors.

sa: स्तमोवृता द्यौर्विचचाल भूमिः। पपात चोल्का ज्वलनप्रकाशा निशाचराश्चाप्यभवन् प्रहृष्टाः॥
en: At Karna's death all the minor points of compass were ablaze. The sky was enshrouded with darkness. The Earth shook. Burning meteors dropped. The Rakshasas and other night rangers were filled with joy.

sa: पुण्डरीकनिभा भाति पुण्डरीकान्तरप्रभा। मुखं विमृज्य पुत्रस्य भर्तुश्चैव तपस्विनी।॥
en: Having a complexion like that of the filaments of the lotus, she looks beautiful like a lotus. The hapless princess, now rubs the face of her son, and again that of her husband.

sa: ज्येष्ठानुज्येष्ठपत्नीनां भ्रातृणां पुत्रनप्तृणाम्। निग्रहानुग्रहौ पार्थ गार्हस्थ्यमिति तत् तपः॥
en: Granting favours and inflicting punishments upon the wives of brothers elder and younger and upon their sons and grandsons, constitute the domestic duties of a king and these are also his best penances.

sa: वृद्ध्या कृषिवणिक्त्वेन जीवसंजीवनेन च। वेत्तुमर्हसि राजेन्द्र स्वाध्यायगणितं महत्॥
en: You should therefore, o king, consider the study of the Vedas, which is endued with such high merit, the manliness of kingly power, the pursuits of agriculture, trade, and hunting as all equal.

sa: भृकुटीकृतवक्त्रान्तं क्रोधादुवृत्तचक्षुषम्। सामर्षं तं नरव्याघ्रं व्याघ्रं निपतितं यथा।॥
en: His forehead was contracted into furrows of rage and his eyes were rolling in anger. They saw the king, that foremost of men, full of rage, like a tiger struck down (by hunters).

sa: स चेन्ममार संजय चतुर्भद्रतरस्त्वया। पुत्रात् पुण्यतश्चैव मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः॥
en: When he, O Srinjaya, who was superior to you in the four principal attributes and who was purer than your son, met with death, do not grieve for your son who is dead.

sa: ततः प्रीतस्तु दैत्येन्द्रो भयमस्याभवन्महत्। वरे प्रदिष्टे विप्रेण नाल्पतेजायमित्युत॥
en: At this, though pleased, Prahlada became stricken with a great fear. Indeed when this boon was indicated by the Brahmana, the Asura king thought that the solicitor could not be an ordinary person.

sa: नित्यमुद्यतदण्डस्य भृशमुद्विजते नरः। तस्मात् सर्वाणि भूतानि दण्डेनैव प्रसाधयेत्॥
en: On seeing a king who has the rod of punishment ever uplifted in his hand, every one is filled with fear. Therefore, the king should rule all creatures with the rod of punishment.

sa: स चेन्ममार संजय चतुर्भद्रतरस्त्वया। पुत्रात् पुण्यतरश्चैव मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः॥
en: When he, O Srinjaya, who was superior to you in the four principal attributes and who was purer than your son, met with death, do not grieve for your son who is dead.

sa: तत्र शल्यरथं राजन् विचरन्तं महाहवे। अपश्याम यथापूर्वं शक्रस्यासुरसंक्षये॥
en: Then, O king, we behalf the car of Shalya moving about in that dreadful battle like the car of Shakra in days of yore on the occasion of the destruction of the Asuras.

sa: तेनापि समनुज्ञातो भार्गवेण महात्मना। श्रेयोऽस्तीति पुनर्भूयः शुक्रमाह शतक्रतुः॥
en: Acquiring the permission of the great Bhargava, the celebrator of a hundred sacrifices once more asked the sage as to whether there was anything superior to what the sage had already told him.

sa: सोऽहमन्त्यावसायानां हराम्येनां प्रतिग्रहात्। न स्तैन्यदोषं पश्यामि हरिष्यामि श्वजाघनीम्॥
en: I shall then, at this time when my life itself is almost gone, steal this meat. I do not see sin in such theft. I shall, therefore, steal this haunch of dog's meat.

sa: ग्रामान् निष्क्रम्य मुनयो विगतक्रोधमत्सराः। वने कुटुम्बधर्माणो दृश्यन्ते परिमोहिताः॥
en: There are men who controlling anger and pride love like ascetics and abandoning villages and towns repair to the forests. Coming there, those men become so stupefied that they live like householder again.

sa: उपलभ्य मतिं चाय्यामरिमित्रान्तरं तथा॥ संधिविग्रहकालौ च मोक्षोपायस्तथैव च।
en: Deriving a great lesson from that story, and learning the difference between friend and enemy and the proper time for war and peace, You will discover means of escape when beset with dangers.

sa: निहन्तुमार्यः पुरुषव्रते स्थितः। दुवाच किं पाण्डव हे प्रमाद्यसे॥
en: The honorable Arjuna, always following the duties of a hero, did not like to kill him in that plight. Then Indra's younger brother respectfully said "why do you make a mistake, OPandu's son?

sa: ततः स्तुतिपुराणज्ञा रक्तकण्ठाः सुशिक्षिताः। अस्तुवन् विश्वकर्माणं वासुदेवं प्रजापतिम्॥
en: Then a number of well-trained and sweet voiced persons conversant with hymns and the Puranas, began to sing the praises of Vasudeva, the master of all creatures and the creator of the universe.

sa: ऊर्ध्वं भवति संदेहादिह दृष्टार्थमेव च। अपेक्षापूर्वकरणात् प्रायश्चित्तं विधीयते॥
en: Expiation has been laid down, for an act undertaken for the purpose of doing mischief (to some one) in the future, as well as for an act done whose consequence is apparently mischievous.

sa: स चेन्ममार संजय चतुर्भद्रतरस्त्वया। पुत्रात् पुण्यतरश्चैव मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः॥
en: When he, O Srinjaya, who was superior to you in the four principal attributes and who was purer than your son, met with death, do not grieve for your son who is dead.

sa: बुद्धिश्रेष्ठानि कर्माणि बाहुमध्यानि भारत। तानि जवाजघन्यानि भारप्रत्यवराणि च॥
en: All acts that are performed with the help of intelligence are regarded as the highest, those performed, with the help of feet are inferior, while those done by carrying loads are the worst.

sa: तत् पुनस्तुमुलं युद्धं प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वाभ्यवर्तत॥ तावकानां परेषां च परस्परवधैषिणाम्।
en: Again a dreadful encounter took place, in which the combatants did not care for their lives, between your soldiers and those of the foe, all of whom were desirous of killing one another.

sa: पिङ्गेक्षणसटं यस्य रूपं दंष्ट्रनखायुधम्। दानवेन्द्रान्तकरणं तस्मै दृप्तात्मने नमः॥
en: Assuming the form of man-lion with twany eyes and twany manes with teeth and claws for your weapons, you had killed the king of the Asuras. Salutations to your form of great subtility.

sa: नित्यं पूजितमस्माभिरभिकामं च नः सदा। प्रौढमत्यद्भुताकारं पुरस्ताद् दृष्टविक्रमम्॥
en: The warriors therein are ever well-treated by us and they are attached to us very much. The army is not newly recruited and its aspect is wonderful. Its efficiency has been tested previously.

sa: मायान्वितैर्वा रक्षोभिः सुघोरैर्दृढवैरिभिः। विपरीतं मतं जातं व्यासस्यापि महात्मनः॥
en: Next she feared that some cruel and strong Rakshasas, endued with the prowess of deception, had killed them. And she asked herself, “Could the illustrious Vyasa himself have been guided by perverse intelligence?"

sa: तदिन्द्रजालप्रतिम बाणजालममित्रहा। विसृज्य दिक्षु सर्वासु महेन्द्र इव वज्रभृत्॥
en: Like the great Indra, the holder of the thunder-bolt, that destroyer of enemies viz., Arjuna, shot from his bow in every direction that shower of arrows which resembled a sight produced by magic.

sa: तमिमं गुणसम्पन्नमार्यं च पितरं गुरुम्। अर्घ्यमर्चितमर्चाहँ सर्वे संक्षन्तुमर्हथ॥
en: Therefore, you should approve the worship offered to one who is endued with such accomplishments, who is (our) preceptor, father, and Guru, and who is worthy of the Arghya and of the worship.

sa: तदेनमसुरश्रेष्ठं त्रैलोक्येनापि दुर्जयम्। जहि त्वं योगमास्थाय मावमंस्थाः सुरेश्वर॥
en: This foremost of Asuras is, therefore incapable of being defeated by even the threeworlds in a body. Helped by Yoga, do you kill him, O king of the celestials. Do not neglect him.

sa: द्रावयेयं शरैश्चापि सेन्द्रान् देवान् समागतान्। सराक्षसगणान् पार्थ सासुरोरगमानवान्॥
en: I can with my arrows rout and crush the assembled host of the celestials led by Indra himself, O Partha, assisted though they be by the Rakshasas, thc Asuras, Snakes and human bcings.

sa: रोषानिलसमुद्भूतो मनोऽभिप्रायशीघ्रगः। मर्मातिगो वाणधरस्तुमुलः शोणितोदकैः॥ सम्लावयन् दिशः सर्वा मानवैरास्तरन् महीम्। भीमनि: स्वनितो रौद्रो दुर्योधनपुरोगमान्॥ युद्धेऽभ्यषिञ्चद् विजयो गापत्रैः शिलाशितैः। गाण्डीवं धारयन् धीमान् कीदृशं वो मनस्तदा।॥
en: Whose ire is like a dreadful cloud, who is fleet like the mind or the wind, who always pierces the enemy to the very core of his heart, who, armed with shafts, is dreadful to gaze at, who profusely fills all the cardinal quarters with human blood like Death himself, who, with a terrific roar and a dreadful countenance, wielding the Gandiva, pours, in one continuous shower, on the head of my warriors led by Duryodhana, shafts whetted on stone and decked with the feathers of vultures, when that intelligent Vijaya came, what became the state of your mind.

sa: एवमासीत् तदा वीरे शरवर्षेण संवृते। फाल्गुने भरतश्रेष्ठ तद्युतमिवाभवत्।॥
en: Such was the aspect which all nature assumed when that hero was overwhelmed with showers of arrows. Indeed, when Phalguna, that foremost one among the Bharatas, was thus afflicted, those marvels were witnessed.

sa: तमाश्रमपदं प्राप्तमृर्भार्या समार्चयत्। स युद्धमदसम्मत्तो नाभ्यनन्दत् तथार्चनम्॥ प्रमथ्य चाश्रमात् तस्माद्धोमधेनोस्तथा बलात्। जहार वत्सं क्रोशन्त्या बभञ्ज च महादुमान्॥
en: When he came to the hermitage, he was hospitably received by the Rishi's wife. But proud of prowess, he was not pleased with the reception. By force and in defiance of all resistance, he seized and carried off from the hermitage the chief cow whose milk supplied the sacred Ghee, not at all heeding the loud lowing of her calf. And he wantongly pulled down the trees of the forest.

sa: धनंजयो स्थानीकमन्वपद्यत वीर्यवान्॥ माद्रीपुत्रो च शकुनि सात्यकिश्च महाबलः।
en: In the meantime the highly energetic Dhananjaya proceeded towards the car-division of the Kurus. The twin sons of Madri and the mighty car-warrior Satyaki, all strong, cheerfully rushed against Shakuni for slaying him.

sa: बाणशब्दान् बहुविधान् नराश्वरगज वाजिनाम्॥ ज्यातलत्रेषुशब्दांश्च शृणु कर्ण महात्मनाम्।
en: The whizz of the various sorts of shafts and the noise of chariots, horses and men is also being heard. Listen, O Karna, to the twang of the bows of the various warriors.

sa: सायकानां ततः पार्थस्रिषष्ट्या प्रत्यविध्यत। तोत्रैरिव महानागं कशभिरिव वाजिनम्॥
en: Then with a group of sixty-three arrows Pritha's son, pierced Karna in return like a driver goring his elephant with so many hooks or a horseman lacerating his animal with so many whips.

sa: यदि नाहं परित्याज्यो भवद्भ्यां पुरुषर्षभौ। युध्यतामनुरूपेण विक्रमेण सुविक्रमौ॥
en: If, O foremost of men, I do not deserve to be forsaken by you, then do you fight according to the measure of your prowess, O you that are possessed of great prowess.

sa: पदातयो हि संरब्धास्त्यक्तजीवितबान्धवाः॥ भीममभ्यद्रवन् संख्ये पतङ्गा इव पावकम्।
en: These foot-soldiers, worked up with great anger, having lost their friends and kinsmen, were prepared to cast away their lives and rushed in that battle towards Bhima like insects towards a blazing fire.

sa: अधिभूतं तथा शुक्र दैवतं च प्रजापतिः। हस्तावध्यात्ममित्याहुरध्यात्मविदुषो जनाः॥
en: As connected with objects, it is the vital sec; and the presiding deity is Prajapati. The two hands are mentioned as connected with the soul by persons knowing the relations of the soul.

sa: धर्मश्रुतिसमुत्कर्षो धर्मसेतुरनामयः। आर्षो वै शाश्वतो नित्यमव्ययोऽयं मया श्रुतः॥
en: Duties are the foremost of Shrutis. Duties form the eternal path. I have listened to this discourse of the Rishis (on duties) that is eternal and immutable, and that is above all change.

sa: युद्धश्रद्धामहं तेऽद्य विनेष्यामि रणाजिरे। इत्युक्त्वा क्रोधताम्राक्षो राक्षसः परवीरहा।॥
en: I will today put an end to your desire for fight on the field of battle.” Saying this, the Rakshasa (Ghatotkacha), the slayer of hostile warriors-with his eyes red like copper in wrath.

sa: कदाचित् तु तथैवास्य विनिष्क्रान्ताः सुताः प्रभो। अथानूपपतिर्वीरः कार्तवीर्योऽभ्यवर्तत॥
en: O lord, once at a time when his sons had again gone out (to gather fruits), the mighty son of Kirtavirya, the king of the country near the sea-shore, came to the hermitage.

sa: अभिषिक्तस्त्वमस्माभिरयोध्यां पालने व्रज। विजित्य तरसा लोकान् मरुद्भिरिव वासवः॥
en: Having been installed, go to Ayodhyā for the purpose of governing it, having with our assistance conquered your enemies by they strength, like Vāsava conquering (his foes) with the help of the Maruts.

sa: श्येन उवाच इन्द्रोऽहमस्मिधर्मज्ञ कपोतो हव्यवाडयम्। जिज्ञासमानौधर्म त्वां यज्ञवाटमुपागतौ॥
en: The Hawk said : O virtuous king, I am Indra. The pigeon is the carrier of the sacrificial Ghee (Agni). In order to test your virtuous merit, we came to your sacrificial grounds,

sa: त्वामृतेऽपि हि दुष्यन्त शैलराजावतंसकाम्। चतुरन्ताभिमामुर्वी पुत्रो मे पालयिष्यति॥
en: But, ( Dushyanta, (know this for a certainty), that when you are dead, my this son shall rule the whole earth, surrounded by the four seas and adorned by the king of mountains.

sa: करोति कर्म यद् वैश्यस्तद् गत्वा ह्युपजीवति। कृषिगोरक्ष्यवाणिज्यमकुत्सा वैश्यकर्माणि॥
en: A Vaishya lives by distributing the fruits of his own deeds and agriculture. The breeding of kine and trade are the legitimate duties in which a Vaishya may engage without fear of censure.

sa: गाङ्गेयं वार्युपस्पृश्य प्राणायामेन तस्थिवान्। शुचिः प्रयतवाग् भूत्वा स्तोत्रमारब्धवांस्ततः॥
en: Purifying himself with the touch of the Ganges water and restraining his speech, he practised Pranayama (one of the processes of Yoga) for some time and he then recite this hymn of praise.

sa: तद् दृष्ट्वा तादृशं युद्धं द्रोणपाण्डवयोस्तदा। वासुदेवो महाबुद्धिः कार्यवत्तामचिन्तयत्॥
en: Then beholding that battle between Drona and the son of Pandu, the highly intelligent son of Vasudeva began to think about the accomplishment of the (more important) task (viz., the slaughter of Jayadratha).

sa: रथाक्षमात्रैरिषुभिः सर्वाः प्रच्छादयन् दिशः॥ तस्यां वीरापहारिण्यां निशायां कर्णमभ्ययात्।
en: Filling all the quarters of the heaven with arrows of the measures of the Aksha of a car, the Rakshasa assailed Karna in that night that witnessed the destruction of so many heroes.

sa: भुक्तवत्सु द्विजेन्द्रेषु यथावत् सम्प्रदापयेत्। वाचकं भरतश्रेष्ठ भोजयित्वा स्वलंकृतम्॥
en: After entertaining a number of foremost Brahmanas, presents should be made to them according to the ordinances. The reciter also, O chief of the Bharatas, should be decked with ornaments and fed sumptuously.

sa: शरणं गच्छ कौन्तेय वरदं भुवनेश्वरम्॥ उमापतिं विरूपाक्षं दक्षयज्ञनिबर्हणम्।
en: O son of Kunti, seek the refuge of at lord of the universe, who bestows boons, who is the lord of Uma, who possesses three-eyes and who is the destroyer of Daksha's sacrifice;

sa: पुण्यमाहुः कुरुक्षेत्रं कुरुक्षेत्रात् सरस्वती। सरस्वत्याश्च तीर्थानि तीर्थेभ्यश्च पृथूदकम्॥
en: The learned men say that Kurukshetra is holy, holier than Kurukshetra is the Sarasvati, holier than the Sarasvati are all the Tirthas put together and holier than all the Tirthas is the Prithudaka.

sa: यावन्नायाति वार्ष्णेयः कर्षन् यादववाहिनीम्। राज्यार्थे पाण्डवेयानां पाञ्चाल्यसदनं प्रति॥
en: As long as Vasudeva, Krishna, does not march with the Yadava hosts into the city of the Panchala king in order to restore the Pandavas to their kingdom, so long display your prowess.

sa: कुरुक्षेत्रे गमिष्यामि कुरुक्षेत्रे वसाम्यहम्॥ अप्येकां वाचमुत्सृज्य सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते।
en: He who lives in this region really lives in heaven. "I will go to Kurukshetra, I will live in Kurukshetra,” he who utters these words even once becomes cleansed of all his sins.

sa: सूर्यरूपाणि चाभान्ति दीप्ताग्निसदृशानि च। मणिजालविचित्राणि प्रांशूनि निबिडानि च॥
en: They are lustrous like the rays of the sun; and are blazing like the fire and set with cluster of gems and precious stones; they are high and stand close to one another.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा तं महावाहुर्जगामानवलोकयन्। श्वाप्येकोऽनुययौ यस्ते बहुशः कीर्तितो मया।॥
en: Having said these words, the mighty-armed Yudhishthira went on, withoui loO king back. He had only one companion, viz., the dog of which I have repeatedly spoken to you which followed hiin now.

sa: न संनिपतितं धर्म्यमुपभोगं यदृच्छया। प्रत्याचक्षे न चाप्येनमनुरुध्ये सुदुर्लभम्॥
en: I never reject such enjoyments as are not inconsistent with virtue and as can be secured without effort. I do not at the same time, stir myself for gaining objects difficult of acquisition.

sa: तस्य सर्वाणि रक्ष्याणि दूरतः परिवर्जयेत्। मृत्योरिव जुगुप्सेत राजस्वहरणान्नरः॥
en: One should turn away from the king's property as he would from death itself. A person, by taking what belongs to the king, soon meets with destruction like a deer upon touching poison.

sa: नखदंष्ट्रायुधान् वीरान् सिंहशार्दूलविक्रमान्। वानरान् वारणेन्द्राभान् क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि संगतान्॥
en: And soon shall you behold the assembled heroic monkeys, endowed with the prowess of lions and tigers, and the splendour of the monarch of monkeys, and having nails and teeth for their arms.

sa: तस्याक्षहृदयज्ञस्य शरीरानि:सृतः कलिः। कर्कोटकविषं तीक्ष्णं मुखात् सततमुद्वमन्॥ कलेस्तस्य तदार्तस्य शापाग्निः स विनिःसृतः। स तेन कर्शिता राजा दीर्घकालमनात्मवान्॥
en: When he (Nala) thus acquired the knowledge of this art of playing at dice Kali came out of his body; while he continued to vomit from his mouth the most virulent poison of Karkotaka. Then that fire of curse (by Damayanti), by which Kali had greatly been afflicted, also came out of his body. In fact, the king, like one of unregenerate soul, had long remained repressed by him (Kali).

sa: यथालब्धेन कर्तव्यः संतोषस्तेन मैथिलि। यताहारैर्वनचरैः सीते दुःखमतो वनम्॥
en: Those that dwell in the forest will have to remain content, having practised moderation in food, O Maithill, with whatever edibles are attainable in the forest; so the wood is full of misery.

sa: तावेकस्थो रणे वीरावावन्त्यौ रथिनां वरौ। शरान् मुमुग्रतुस्तूर्णमिरावति महात्मनि॥
en: Then those two foremost of car-warriors endued with heroism and riding on one and the same car, both belonging to the country of Avanti, began to shower incessantly arrows on the high-souled Iravat.

sa: सुपूर्णायतमुक्तैस्ताव्यवच्छिन्नपिण्डितैः॥ पञ्च षट् सप्त चाष्टौ च बिभेद यवनाशरैः।
en: With his arrows disc!larged from his bow drawn to the fullest exicnt and flying in a continuous line, that brave warrior began to slay, five, six, seven or eight Yavanas at a time.

sa: क्लिष्टरूपामसंस्पर्शादयुक्तामिव वल्लकीम्। स तां भर्तृहिते युक्तामयुक्तां रक्षसां वशे॥ अशोकवनिकामध्ये शोकसागरमाप्लुताम्। ताभिः परिवृतां तत्र सग्रहामिव रोहिणीम् ॥
en: Her beauty was greatly faded (in consequence of her husband's separation) like to a stringed instrument for want of a player. And ever engaged in her husband's welfare she was thoroughly unworthy of being brought under the control of the Rākşasas. Being sunk in the abyss of grief and encircled by those Rākşasīs she appeared in the forest of Asoka like to Rohiņi possessed by Rāhu.

sa: तं वै सदा कामचरमनुपस्तीर्णशायिनम्। बाहूपधानं शाम्यन्तं प्रशंसन्ति दिवौकसः॥
en: The very gods praise such a man who wnders about according to his will who lies down on the naked Earth with his arm for a pillow, and who possesses a tranquil soul.

sa: तं चिताग्निगतं वीरं शूरपुत्रं वराङ्गनाः। ततोऽन्वारुरुहुः पत्न्यश्चतस्रः पतिलोकगाः॥
en: The four wives of that heroic son of Shura ascended the funeral pyre and were consumed with the body of their husband. All of them attained to those happy regions which were his.

sa: अन्या वक्षसि चान्यस्यास्तस्याः काचित् पुनर्भुजम्। अपरा त्वङ्कमन्यस्यास्तस्याश्चाप्यपरा कुचौ॥
en: And some were lying on others' bosoms; and others again, on the arms of the latter. And some lay on the laps of others; and others, again, on the breasts of the latter.

sa: दन्तिनां युध्यमानानां संघर्षात् पावकोऽभवत्। दन्तेषु भरतश्रेष्ठ सधूमः सर्वतोदिशम्॥
en: On all sides, O foremost of the Bharatas, were seen scintications of fire mixed with smoke emitted from the tusks of elephants in consequence of friction, as they fought on with one another.

sa: तमेवमुपलक्ष्यैको हृष्टः पुष्टः परंतप॥ दुर्योधनप्रिये युक्तः पाण्डवान् परिशोचयन्।
en: While fighting with the great warriors (Shveta), that chastiser of foes, Bhishma was the only one who was cheerful. Ever devoted to the welfare of Duryodhana, he began to consume the warriors (Shveta).

sa: तैर्यतद्भिरियं सत्या श्रुता सत्यवतस्तव। प्रतिज्ञा सिन्धुराजस्य वधे राजीवलोचन॥
en: Thus when those vow-observing heroes were preparing for the battle, O you of eyes like lotus petals, they heard of the true vow you had taken for the slaughter of the Sindhu king.

sa: ततो जघान संक्रुद्धो वासविस्तां महाचमूम्। शरजालैरविच्छिन्नस्तमः सूर्य इवांशुभिः॥
en: Then the son of Vasava, (Arjuna) wrought up with rage, began to destroy that mighty host with his continuous network of arrows, like the rays of the sun destroying the darkness (of night).

sa: तं वाहनमाहानौभिर्योधा जयधनैषिणः। अवगाह्याथ मज्जन्तो नैव मोहं प्रचक्रिरे॥
en: Warriors desirous of the wealth of victory launching into that sea on board the vessels consisting of their respective vehicles, produced stupefaction in their enemies instead of themselves sinking down to the bottom.

sa: श्लाघतेऽयं सदा वीर पार्थस्य गुणविस्तरैः। पुत्रादभ्यधिकं चैनं भारद्वाजोऽनुपश्यति॥
en: This one (Drona) ever prides himself on the many accomplishments of the son of Pritha, O hero, and the son of Bharadvaja looks on him with greater affection than on his own son.

sa: भजस्व मां विशालाक्ष स्वयं कन्यामुपस्थिताम्। अनन्यपूर्वां राजेन्द्र त्वत्प्रसादाभिकाक्षिणीम्॥
en: Accept me, O you of big eyes, who am a girl and have come of my own will desirous of your favours, and without having been ravished by another, O chief among kings."

sa: मूर्छयाऽभिपरीताङ्गौ व्यायामेन तु मोहितौ। ततोऽभ्यधावद् वेगेन करकर्षः सुहृत्तया॥
en: Their limbs were stiffened in a swoon and they lost their consciousness through the fatigue (of their exertions). Thereupon the king of the Kauravas, out of friendship, rushed (to the rescue of Chekitana,

sa: द्वैधीभूता महाराज गङ्गेवासाद्य पर्वतम्। द्रोणमेवान्वपद्यन्त केचित् तत्र नरर्षभाः॥
en: Became split up in twain, like a current of Ganges water dividing into two streams when it is obstructed by a hillock. Some among those foremost of men, then sought shelter from Drona.

sa: सम्मर्दयानः स्वबलं वायुर्वृक्षानिवौजसा। तस्मिन् पराजिते नागे पाण्डवानां महारथाः॥
en: Crushing the army to which it belonged, like the strong wind crushing the trees with its velocity. When that elephant of the Dasharna king was defeated, the mighty car-warriors of the Pandava host,

sa: सोऽहमेवंगते. कृष्ण निमग्नः शोकसागरे। आत्मनो बुद्धिदौर्बल्याद् भीष्ममासाद्य संयुगे॥
en: When, O Krishna, such is the state of affairs, I am, in consequence of the weakness of my own understanding, sunk in sorrow, having to fight with Bhishma as an opponent in battle.

sa: तं विद्याद् दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम्। स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा॥
en: That state should be understood to be called Yoga, in which there is a complete severance of all connection with pain. Such Yoga should be practised with steadiness, and with an undisponding heart.

sa: उद्भ्रान्तैस्तुरगैः सोऽथ द्रवमाणैः समन्ततः। मागधौऽपसृतो राजा सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Then borne by the unrestrained steeds flying hither and thither, the ruler of the Magadhas was carried away from the field of battle even before the every eyes of the onloO king troops.

sa: तस्य दीप्तो महाकाय: स्वान्यनीकानि हर्षयन्॥ हस्तिकक्ष्यो महाकेतुर्बभौ सूर्यसमद्युतिः।
en: His mighty standard, huge and resplendent and marked with the device of the elephant's girth, imparting delight into the hearts of his own soldiers, burned with effulgence cqual to that of the sun.

sa: द्रष्टासि श्वो महेष्वासान् नाराचैस्तिग्मतेजितैः। शृङ्गाणीव गिरेर्वत्रैर्दार्यमाणान् मया युधि॥
en: Tomorrow you shall behold the mighty bowmen (of the enemy's host), rent open by me with Narachas of fierce energy, like the crests of the mountains cleft open by the bolt of Heaven.

sa: अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात् परमात्माऽयमव्ययः। शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते॥
en: This inexhaustible Supreme Self, O son of Kunti, without having beginning and without having attributes, does not act at all. It is in no way stained, even when it remains in (human body).

sa: अयसामिव सम्पातः शिलानामिव चाभवत्। दीव्यतां तुमुले युद्धे प्राणैरमिततेजसाम्॥
en: When those heroes of immeasurable energy played in that battle, as if in a game of dice, staking their very lives, there seemed to be a collision of iron against adamant. the army

sa: न हि शक्यो रणे पार्थः सैन्ट्रैर्देवासुरैरपि। प्रत्युद्यातुमतस्तात नैतदामर्षयाम्यहम्॥
en: Even the celestials with Indra at their head and united with the Asuras theinselves, cannot cope with Partha in battle; for this reason, O son, I do not venture to advance against him.

sa: क्षुत्पिपासेऽजयद् रामः सर्वरोगांश्च देहिनाम्। सततं गुणसम्पन्नो दीप्यमानः स्वतेजसा॥
en: Rama conquered hunger and thirst and he was beyond the influence of maladies that trouble the corporeal creation. He was always attended with all kinds of virtues and burnt in his own energy.

sa: आचार्यस्यार्धचन्द्रेण क्रुद्धश्चिच्छेद कार्मुकम्। सोमदत्तस्य भल्लेन ध्वजं चोन्मथ्य चानदत्॥
en: He then burst asunder the bow of the preceptor Drona with a crescent shaped arrow. Then with a broad headed arrow, having caused the standard of Somadatta, he broke out into another yell.

sa: तं तेऽभिषिषिचुर्बाणैर्मेघा गिरिमिवाम्बुभिः। स तु तान् प्रममाथैको विष्वग्वातोयथाम्बुदान्॥
en: These warriors all showered arrows of him (Abhimanyu), like clouds showering in torrents rains on mountains; he, in return, though single-handed, routed them like the dry and confused wind scattering masses of clouds.

sa: तमेकं समरे भीष्मं त्वरमाण महारथम्। पाण्डवाः समवर्तन्त वज्रहस्तमिवासुराः॥
en: Then like the Asuras assailing the wielder of the thunder bolt, the Pandavas assailed, in a body, that single-handed mighty car-warrior Bhishma who was moving swiftly up and down the field of battle.

sa: शिखण्डी तु रणे राजन् विव्याधैव पितामहम्। शरैरशनिसंस्पर्शस्तथा सर्पविषोपमैः॥
en: Shikhandin also, O monarch, pierced the grandsire in battle with sharp arrows, of which the touch resembled that of the bolt of heaven and which were mortal like the virulent venom of snakes.

sa: असकृत् क्षत्रियवाताः संख्ये येन विनिर्जिताः। जामदग्न्येन वीरेण परवीरनिघातिना॥
en: That great intelligent one, who was not killed even by that slayer of hostile heroes, that Rama, the son of Jamadagni who defeated in battle all Kshatriyas, has now been killed by Shikhandin,.

sa: ततस्तामेव शल्यस्य सौभद्रः परवीरहा। मुमोच भुजवीर्येण वैदूर्यविकृतां शिताम्॥
en: There after the son of Subhadra, that slayer of hostile heroes, let go, charging with the might of his arms, the self same dart of Shalya of great resplendence and decked with lapises.

sa: नैव कर्णो न ते पञ्च ददृशुर्बाणसंवृताः। साश्वसूतध्वजरथाः परस्परशराचिताः॥
en: Neither they nor Karna was to be seen being covered over with (clouds of) shafts. Their steeds, drivers and standards and cars were all lost to sight being covered with thick arrowy showers.

sa: शस्त्रवृष्टिं परैर्मुक्ता शरौधैर्यदवारयत्। न च तत्राप्यनिर्भिन्नः कश्चिदासीद् विशाम्पते॥
en: In as much as he baffled the thick shower of arrows discharged by his enemies with myriad of shafts shot by himself. There was none, O ruler of men, that was not wounded.

sa: निकारो निकृतिप्रज्ञैः पाण्डवैस्त्वत्प्रतीक्षया। अनुभूतः सहामात्यैः क्षान्तश्च सुचिरं वने॥
en: The Pandavas are thoroughly unacquainted with the ways of wickedness. For a long time। loO king up to your face, they (silently) suffered the injury and forgave them though exiled in the forest.

sa: आय॑शृङ्गि महेष्वासं मायाविनमरिंदमम्। वैरिणं भीमसेनस्य पूर्वं बकवधेन वै॥
en: That fierce bowman, that subduer of foes, that one of great illusive energies, viz., Alambusha the son of Rishyashringa, who was the enemy of Bhimasena, in consequence of the latter's slaughter of Vaka.

sa: इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत। सर्वभूतानि सम्मोहं सर्गे यान्ति परंतप॥
en: All beings, O terror of foes, at the time of their birth, are deluded by this delusion arising, O Bharata, from the pairs of opposites, and from the results of desire and aversion.

sa: वृषदंशं च शैलेन्द्र महामन्दरमेव च। अप्सरोभिः समाकीर्णं किन्नरैचोपशोभितम्॥
en: Then he arrived at that foremost of hills known as Vrisha-Dansha and also the hill called the great Mandara, both of which were thickly peopled by the Apsaras and beautified by the Kinnaras.

sa: न निवर्तितपूर्वश्च कदाचिद् रणमूर्धनि) निवर्त्यतामापगेयः कामं युद्धात् पितामहाः॥
en: Before this, I had never been made to turn beak (from combat) on the field of battle. O grandsires, make the Ganga's son of desist from the battle, if it so pleases you.

sa: भ्रमरैरिव चाविष्टा द्रोणस्य निशितैः शरैः। अन्योन्यं समलीयन्त पलायनपरायणा:॥
en: Like a tree penetrated by a cluster of bees, they are being pierced by the keen-pointed arrows of Drona; they are huddling together as they are hastening away from the field of battle.

sa: अथोत्क्रुष्टं महेष्वासैः पाण्डवैर्युद्धदुर्मदैः॥ समुद्यते पार्थिवेन्द्रे पार्षते शत्रुसूदने। तमब्रवीत् ततः पार्थः पार्षतं पृतनापितम्॥ व्यूहः क्रौञ्चारुणो नाम सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणः।
en: When the chastiser of foes, that foremost of princes, that descendant of Pritha (Dhrishtadyumna) defiantly spoke thus, the Pandava warriors, who were all greatly powerful, who were all incapable of being defeated, sent forth a loud shout. Then the son of Pritha, Yudhishthira, thus spoke to the descendant of Prishat (Dhrishtadyumna), the commander of his army, "A Vyuha called Krauncharuna which is destructive of all foes.

sa: सर्वरत्नसमाकीर्णे पुंसां देशे मनोरमे। इत्येवं धृतराष्ट्रस्य वचनाच्चक्रिरे कथाः॥
en: The procession is the most grand in the world; and all gems and jewels (now) there delight the heart." Thus did they (counsellors) under instruction from Dhritarashtra, speak (of the city). O sons,

sa: सत्यवादी शमपरस्तपस्वी नियतव्रतः। सर्वेषामेव नो मान्यः स तावत्प्रतिपाल्यताम्॥
en: He is truthful, a lover of peace, a Rishi of hard austerities and an observer of the ordained penances. He is respected by all of us and we should, therefore, wait for him.

sa: दशसूनासमं चक्रं दशचक्रसमो ध्वजः। दशध्वजसमा वेश्या दशवेश्यासमो नृपः॥
en: One oilman is equal to ten butchers. Equal to ten oilmen is one drinker of alcohol. Equal to ten drinkers of alcohol is one harlot. Equal to ten harlots is a single king.

sa: अनायसेन शस्त्रेण मृदुना हृदयच्छिदा। जिह्वामुद्धर सर्वेषां परिमृज्यानुमृज्य च॥
en: Use then a weapon which is not made of steel, which is very mild and yet capable of piercing all hearts. Sharpening that weapon again and again rectify the tongues of your kinsmen!

sa: यथैधः स्वसमुत्थेन वह्निना नाशमृच्छति। तथाकृतात्मा लोभेन सहजेन विनश्यति॥
en: As a faggot of wood is consumed by the fire that is fed by that faggot, so a person of impure soul meets with destruction from the covetousness born in his own heart.

sa: नन्विमेधनुषि श्रेष्ठा अजेया युधि शात्रवैः। किमर्थंधार्तराष्ट्राणां सहन्ते दुर्बलीयसाम्॥
en: They are all foremost of all bowmen and they are all invincible in battle by any foe. Why do they (silently) bear the wrongs inflicted (on me) by the weak sons of Dhritarashtra?

sa: द्रष्टुकामस्य चात्यर्थं गतया पार्श्वतस्तया। अन्यदञ्चितपद्माक्षं दक्षिणं निःसृतं मुखम्॥
en: Because he (Shiva) was very much desirous of seeing her, therefore when she came at his side, another face came out on the southern side of his body with eyes like fullblossomed lotuses.

sa: तस्मादनिष्टनाशार्थमितिहासं निबोध मे। तिष्ठते चेद् वशे बुद्धिर्लभते शोकनाशनम्॥
en: Do you, therefore, listen to some old narratives as I recount them to you, for the object of removing your sorrow, If one can subjugate his understanding, he is sure to acquire happiness.

sa: चातुर्विद्यं चातुर्होत्रं चातुराश्रम्यमेव च। राजधर्मांश्च निखिलान् पृच्छैनं पृथिवीपते॥
en: O king enquire of him about the four branches of knowledge, about sacrifices and the rites sanctioned for the four castes, about the four modes of life, and about the duties of kings.

sa: यथोदयगिरौ द्रव्यं संनिकर्षेण दीप्यते। तथा सत्संनिकर्षेण हीनवर्णोऽपि दीप्यते॥
en: As in the Eastern hills, jewels and metals blaze with greater effulgence on account of their nearness to the Sun, so the lowest order shines on account of their association with the good.

sa: आतिथ्यं परमं कार्य शुश्रूषा भवस्तथा। संवर्ततामित्युवाच मुनिर्मधुरया गिरा॥
en: It is proper that I should entertain you with hospitality and that you should be served with propriety. Thus addressed the ascetic Ashtavakra said, in a sweet voice Let the dance go on.

sa: धर्माय येऽभ्यसूयन्ति बुद्धिमोहान्विता नराः। अपथा गच्छतां तेषामनुयाताऽपि पीड्यते॥
en: Those men who are stupefied by erroneous understandings show a hatred for virtue. The man who follows those misguided persons that have taken to devious and wrong paths is afflicted equally with them.

sa: यस्त्वां ध्रुवं वेदयते गुहाशयं प्रभुं पुराणं पुरुषं च विग्रहम्। हिरण्मयं बुद्धिमतां परां गतिं स बुद्धिमान् बुद्धिमतीत्य तिष्ठति॥
en: They who know you the unchangeable, or one who lives in all hearts, or one who is endowed with supreme power, or one who is the ancient Male Being, or one who is pure Knowledge, or one that is the effulgent understanding, or one that is the highest refuge of all persons gifted with intelligence, are, indeed, highly intelligent men. Indeed such persons reign supreme over intelligence. as one seven

sa: अधिष्ठातेति राजेन्द्र प्रोच्यते यतिसत्तमैः। अधिष्ठानादधिष्ठाता क्षेत्राणामिति नः श्रुतम्॥
en: Hence, O great king, the foremost Yatis say that the Soul is the Presider. Indeed, we have heard that on account of the Soul's presiding over all Kshetras. He is called the Presider.

sa: वर्तेत तेषु गृहवानक्रुद्ध्यननसूयकः। पजभिः सततं यज्ञैर्विघसाशी यजेत च॥
en: The Brahmana living like a house-holder should conquer anger and envy, practise the virtues already named, and adoring the gods in the five sacrifices, eat after having fed the gods, Pitris, and guests.

sa: ज्ञानमुत्पद्यते पुंसां क्षयात् पापस्य कर्मणः। यथाऽऽदर्शतले प्रख्ये पश्यत्यात्मानमात्मनि॥
en: From the destruction of all sinful acts, knowledge originates in When Knowledge arises a person sees his Soul in his understanding even as one sees his own image in a polished mirror. men.

sa: श्रेयसः श्रेयसोऽप्येवं वृत्तं लोकोऽनुवर्तते। सदैव हि गुरोर्वृत्तमनुवर्तन्ति मानवाः॥
en: If the king act properly, the high class subjects imitate him. The inferior people, again, imitate their immediate superiors. Men are so formed that they imitate those whom they consider as their betters.

sa: इष्टानिष्टसमायोगे वैरं सौहार्दमेव च। अथ जातिसहस्राणि बहूनि परिवर्तते॥
en: Through the union of both prosperity and adversity, there arise friendships and enmities. Thousands and thousands of existences are continually revolving, and in every mode of individual Soul's existence these must take place.

sa: याः क्रियाः प्रचरिष्यन्ति प्रवृत्तिफलसत्कृताः॥ आभिराप्यायितबला लोकान् वै धारयिष्यथा
en: Indeed, receiving strength from those rites and observances that will be in vogue in the several worlds, originating from the fruits of action, do ye continue to uphold the affairs of those worlds.

sa: एभिः परिवृतो व्यास: शिष्यैः पञ्चभिरुत्तमैः। शुशुभे हिमवत्पादे भूतैर्भूतपतिर्यथा॥
en: Surrounded by these disciples of his, Vyasa shone on the breast of the Himavat mountains like the Lord of all the goblins, viz., Mahadeva, in the midst of those ghostly attendants of his.

sa: साम स्वेनामर्षजेन त्वमृद्धिमोहेन मोहिता। भूयः सृजसि योगांस्त्वं विषामृतमिवैकताम्॥
en: Stupefied by your pride of Yoga power that has been born of your jealousy, you have caused a union of your understanding with mine and thereby have really mingled together nectar with poision.

sa: न चक्षुषा पश्यति रूपमात्मनो न पश्यति स्पर्शनमिन्द्रियेन्द्रियम्। न श्रोत्रलिङ्गं श्रवणेन दर्शनं तथा कृतं पश्यति तद् विनश्यति॥
en: One cannot see the forın of the Soul by his eye, nor can the sense of touch, amongst the senses, apprehend it. The Soul, is not, again, perceived by the ear. It may, however, be seen by the help of the Shrutis and the instructions of the wise. As for senses, that particular senses which apprehends it, loses upon such apprehension its existence as a sense.

sa: सोऽहतामखिलां वृत्तिं त्रिविधां मोक्षसंहिताम्। मुक्तरागश्चराम्येकः पदे परमके स्थितः॥
en: Freed from attachments, and fixing my Soul on Supreme Brahma, and unaffected by companionship, I live, practising in all its minute details that threefold conduct which is laid down in treatises on Liberation.

sa: भीष्म उवाच शुद्धाभिजनसम्पन्नाः पाण्डवाः संशितव्रताः। विहृत्य देवलोकेषु पुनर्मानुषमेष्यथ॥
en: Bhishma said You are Pandavas! you have been born in a stainless family. You are of rigid vows. Having sported happily in the celestial regions, you shall return to the world of men.

sa: एतत् पदमनुद्विग्नमेतद् ब्रह्म सनातनम्। शास्त्रवेदाङ्गविदुषामेतद् ध्यानं परं पदम्॥
en: You are that state which is freed from every anxiety. You are Eternal Brahma. You are that highest state which forms the meditation of persons wellread in the auxiliary branches of the Vedas.

sa: दुर्लभा वेदविद्वांसो वेदोक्तेषु व्यवस्थिताः। प्रयोजनं महत्त्वात्तु मार्गमिच्छन्ति संस्तुतम्॥
en: Rare are persons fully conversant with the Vedas and depending upon the injunctions contained therein. The intelligent however consider the abstention from acts as the better of the two, viz., heaven and liberation.

sa: भविष्यति महासत्त्व ख्यातिश्चाप्यतुला तव। शनैश्चरः सूर्यपुत्रो भविष्यति मनुर्महान्॥
en: You shall be one of the foremost of creatures. Great shall be your fame. The Sun's son Shani (Saturn) will in a future cycle, take birth as the great Manu of that period.

sa: युष्माकं पैतृकं राज्यं भुज्यते तापसात्मजैः। इन्द्रेण भेदितास्ते तु युद्धेऽन्योन्यमपातयन्।॥ तच्छुत्वा तापसी चापि संतप्ता प्ररुरोद ह। ब्राह्मणच्छद्मनाभ्येत्य तामिन्द्रोऽथान्वच्छत॥
en: Hearing this, king Bhangasvana, who was living as an ascetic woman, burning with grief and began to bewail. The king of the gods, viz., Indra, assuming the form of a Brahmana, came where the ascetic lady was living, and meeting her, said you having a beautiful face, with what grief do you burn so that you are thus bewailing? Seeing the Brahmana, the lady told। him in a piteous tone.

sa: निर्वाते तु यथा दीपो ज्वलेत् स्नेहसमन्वितः। निश्चलोखंशिखस्तद्वद् युक्तमाहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: The person in contemplation, the wise hold looks like the fixed and upward flame of a lamp that is full of oil and that burns in a spot where there is no air.

sa: पक्वाशयस्त्वधो नाभ्यामूर्ध्वमामाशय: स्थितः। नाभिमध्ये शरीरस्य सर्वे प्राणाश्च संस्थिताः॥
en: Below the navel is the quarter of digested maller. Above it is that for the food which is taken. In the navel reside all the forces of life that keep up the body.

sa: यथाप्सरोगणाः फलं सुखं महर्षिभिः सह। तथाऽऽनुवन्ति कर्मजं विमानकामगामिनः॥
en: As Apsaras and great Rishis acquires fruits of great happiness, similarly men of righteous deeds, acquire in the other world cars of transcendent brightness that go everywhere at the will of the riders.

sa: एतन्मे भगवानाह कापिलेयस्य सम्भवम्। तस्य तत् कापिलेयत्वं सर्ववित्त्वमनुत्तमम्॥
en: The divine Rishi said to me, all this, regarding the circumstances of his birth and those about his becoming the son of Kapila. The latter also told me about the omniscience of Panchashikha.

sa: इन्द्रियाणि तु तान्याहुस्तेष्वदृश्योऽधितिष्ठति। तिष्ठती पुरुषे बुद्धिस्त्रिषु भावेषु वर्तते॥
en: These modifications of the Understanding are called the senses. The invisible Soul is placed over them as their presiding chief. Living in the body, the Understanding exists in the three states (of qualities).

sa: तमहं प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा मृगपक्षिष्वथाग्निषु। धर्मं च शिष्यवर्गं च समपृच्छमनामयम्॥
en: Joining my hands I made of him the usual enquiries regarding the well-being of the animals and birds who lived in his asylum, of the progress of his righteousness, and of his disciples.

sa: प्रकृत्या नित्यसलिलो नित्यमध्ययने रतः। तपोदमाभ्यां संयुक्तो वृत्तेनानवरेण च॥
en: By nature he does those duties which are performed with or in water. He is given to the study of the Vedas. He is endued with penances and self-control. He has great riches.

sa: तद्भावभावी तबुद्धिस्तदात्मा तदपाश्रयः। तेजसाऽऽवृत्य लोकांस्त्रीन् यशःप्राप्स्यति ते सुतः।।२९।
en: He will be conscious of his being Brahma's self ; his understanding and soul shall be devoted to Brahma, and he shall completely depend upon Brahma so as to be at one with.

sa: संकल्पयित्वा त्रीन् पिण्डान् स्वेनैव विधिना प्रभुः। आत्मगात्रोष्मसम्भूतैः स्नेहगर्भस्तिलैरपि॥ प्रोक्ष्यापसव्यं देवेशः प्राङ्मुखः कृतवान् स्वयम्। मर्यादास्थापनार्थं च ततो वचनमुक्तवान्॥
en: Regarding the three balls of mud that the powerful Lord had shaken off from his tusks as funeral cakes, he then, with sesame seeds that arose from the heat of his own body, himself performed the rite of dedication, sitting with face turned towards the East. That foremost of gods then, moved by the desire of establishing rules of conduct for the inhabitants of the three worlds, said these words.

sa: तद्वज्जातबलो योगी दीप्ततेजा महाबलः। अन्तकाल इवादित्यः कृत्स्नं संशोषयेज्जगत्॥
en: Similarly, the Yogin when grown in strength, burning with energy, and endued with power is capable of scorching the entire Universe like the Sun that rises at the time of the universal dissolution.

sa: यस्त्वेतां नियतश्चर्यां ब्रह्मर्षिविहितां चरेत्। स देहदग्निवद्दोषान् जयेल्लोकांश्च दुर्जयान्॥
en: That person who, with controlled soul, follows such duties originally laid down by regenerate Rishis, consumes all his sins like fire and acquires blissful regions for themselves which are so difficult of attaining.

sa: श्रैष्ठ्यं प्राप्य स्वजातीनां महाभोगाननुत्तमान्। हतस्वरत्नराज्यस्त्वं ब्रूहि कस्मान्न शोचसि॥
en: Formerly, when you were the king of your own order, you enjoyed matchless pleasures. Now, however, you are shorn of your riches and jewels and sovereignty. Tell us why you arc so unmoved.

sa: वेदस्योपनिषत् सत्यं सत्यस्यापनिषद् दमः। दमस्योपनिषद् दानं दानस्योपनिषत् तपः॥
en: The Vedas have truth for their object. Truth has the mastering of the senses for its object. The subjugation of the senses has charity for its object. Charity has penance for its object.

sa: पितृविप्रवधेनाहमार्तो वै पाण्डवाग्रज। शुचिर्भूत्वा महादेवं गतोऽस्मि शरणं नृप॥
en: I was possessed by the sin, O eldest son of Pandu, of Brahmanicide for having killed my brothers who were all learned Brahmanas. Purifying myself, I sought the protection, O king, of Mahadeva.

sa: मुक्तः समः तमतिक्रान्तकर्माणमतिक्रान्तगुणक्षयम्। ब्राह्मणं विषयाश्लिष्टं जरामृत्यू न विन्दतः॥
en: Decrepitude and death cannot attack that Brahma who has got beyond the sphere of acts, who has gone the destruction of the qualities themselves, and who is no longer attached to earthly objects.

sa: देवताभिश्च ये सार्धं पितृभिश्चोपभुञ्जते। रमन्ते पुत्रपौत्रैश्च तेषां गतिरनुत्तमा॥
en: They who share their food with the gods and the Pitris pass their days always happily with their sons and grandsons, and at last, leaving off this body, acquire a very high end.

sa: निहताश्चैव भग्नाश्च पाण्डवेन यशस्विना। चरत बलमास्थाय पाकशासनिना मृधे॥
en: All the troops (of Duryodhana), therefore, were dispersed and killed by that illustrious Pandava, that son of Paka's chastiser, as he moved about in the field of battle, depending on his own strength.

sa: निहताश्चैव भग्नाश्च पाण्डवेन यशस्विना। चरत बलमास्थाय पाकशासनिना मृधे॥
en: All the troops (of Duryodhana), therefore, were dispersed and killed by that illustrious Pandava, that son of Paka's chastiser, as he moved about in the field of battle, depending on his own strength.

sa: एवमन्ये विकुर्वन्ति देवाः संसारमोचनम्। मनुष्याणामृते देवं नान्या शक्तिस्तपोबलम्॥
en: Save the great god who frees creatures from rebirth, all other gods continually nullify the Penances of men, for men have no other source of power that it is as great as these.

sa: आशया ह्यभिपन्नानामकृत्वाचप्रमार्जनम्। राजा वा राजपुत्रो वा भ्रूणहत्यैव युज्यते॥
en: The king or the prince, by refusing to wipe the tears of persons who come to him from hopes of relief, commits the sin of foeticide. By abstaining from speech one acquire wisdom.

sa: भूप्रदानेन च गतिं लभत्याश्रमसम्मिताम्। न्याय्यस्यार्थस्य सम्प्राप्तिं कृत्वा फलमुपाश्नुते॥
en: By giving away land one acquires that high end which is ordained for Rishis leading the sacred mode of life. By acquiring riches through fair means one succeeds in acquiring many desirable fruits.

sa: तस्य चाक्लेशकरणं स्वस्तिकारसमाहितम्। आवर्तयामि तद् ब्रह्म योगयुक्तो निरामयः॥
en: For removing all evil from him and bringing about what is good to him, I am engaged in reciting the Vedas till he comes and am in Yoga and passing my time happily!

sa: नापृष्टः कस्यचिद् ब्रूयान्नाप्यन्यायेन पृच्छतः। ज्ञानवानपि मेधावी जडवत् समुपाविशेत्॥
en: One should not speak until one is asked; nor should one speak when one is asked improperly. Even if endued with intelligence and knowledge, one should still sit in silence like an idiot.

sa: चुक्रोध बलवच्चापि पाण्डवस्तस्य भूपतेः। कार्यविघ्नमनुस्मृत्य पूर्ववैरं च भारत॥
en: Recollecting what an obstacle Vajradatta was proving to the performance of his task, and remembering the old enmity of the house, the son of Pandu became greatly excited with rage against the king.

sa: सर्वभूतानुकम्पी यः सर्वभूतार्जवव्रतः। सर्वभूतात्मभूतश्च स वै धर्मेण युज्यते॥
en: Indeed, that person who shows mercy to all creatures, who adopts as a vow of sincere conduct towards all creatures, and who forms himself the soul of all creatures, becomes gifted with virtue.

sa: वै नक्षत्राणि गृहाश्चैव दिशोऽथ प्रदिशस्तथा। विश्वमूर्तिरमेयात्मा भगवान् परमद्युतिः॥
en: He is the cardinal points of the compass and the subsidiary points also. Of universal form, he is of great soul. The holy and illustrious Durvasas is of the colour of the celestials.

sa: तपसा दीप्यमानास्ते दहेयुः पृथिवीमपि। अपूज्यमानाः कौरव्य पूजार्हास्तु तथाविधाः॥
en: Burning with penances, they are capable of consuming the whole Earth. Such persons, O son of Kuru's race though not generally adored, should still he considered as worthy of adoration in every way.

sa: मनोहृदयनन्दिन्यो विशेषमधुराश्च याः। चारुरूपाः सुमनसो मानुषाणां स्मृता विभो॥
en: Such flowers as please the mind and heart, as are very agreeable when pressed, and as are of beautiful form, have been said, O lord, to be worthy of being offered to men.

sa: माननामहमिच्छामि भवत्यः सततं शिवाः। अप्येकाङ्गेश्वधे वस्तुमिच्छामि च सुकुत्सिते॥
en: Know that I shall always be devoted to you! I wish to live in any part of your bodies, however repulsive it may be. Indeed, I wish to live even in you rectum.

sa: सर्वसंस्कारनिर्मुक्तो निर्द्वन्द्वो निष्परिग्रहः। तपसा इन्द्रियग्रामं यश्चरेन्मुक्त एव सः॥
en: One who is freed from all impressions, who is above all pairs of opposites, who is destitute of all belongings, and who uses all his senses under the guidance of penances, becomes liberated.

sa: अद्येन्द्र स्थापयिष्यामि पश्यतस्ते शतक्रुतम्। संचाल्य पापकर्माणमैन्द्रात् स्थानात् सुदुर्मतिम्॥
en: I shall today, in your very sight, reestablish the true Indra in his position, him, viz., who has celebrated a hundred horse sacrifices, having hurled the wicked and sinful Nahusha from that seat.

sa: ब्रह्मणा वरदत्तास्ता हव्यकव्यप्रदाः शुभाः। पुण्याः पवित्राः सुभगा दिव्यसंस्थानलक्षणाः॥
en: Favoured by Brahman himself with boons, kine are auspicious and givers of Havya and Kavya. They are the embodiments of virtue. They are sacred and highly blessed. They have excellent form and qualities.

sa: सर्वे प्राञ्जलो नागा वृद्धबालपुरोगमाः। शिरोभिः प्रणिपत्योचुः प्रसीद भगवन्निति॥
en: Indeed, all the Nagas placing the old and the young ones before them, bowed to him with their heads and joining their hands addressed him, saying, 'Be pleased with us, O holy one.'

sa: हृष्टपुष्टबलो गच्छेद् राजा वृद्ध्युदये रतः। अकृशश्चाप्यथो यायादनृतावपि पाण्डव॥
en: That king who seeks his own growth and advancement should not march unless he has cheerful and healthy warriors. When strong, O son of Pandu, he may march in even an unfavourable season.

sa: स्वाध्यायनिष्ठा ऋषयो ज्ञाननिष्ठास्तथैव च। तपोनिष्ठाश्च बोद्धव्याः कर्मनिष्ठाश्च भारत॥
en: The gods know thein to he Brahmanas who always walk, O Yudhishthira, within the limits set up by the Rishis who know all duties, and who have a firm faith in their efficacy.

sa: प्राधान्यतस्तु गदतः समासेनैव मे शृणु। कर्माणि पृथिवीशानां यथावदमरधुते॥
en: I shall, however, mention only the foremost of them. Do you listen, therefore, to me as I mention in brief those feats won by the kings of Earth, O you of godlike splendour.

sa: त्रातारं नाधिगच्छन्ति रौद्राः प्राणिविहिंसकाः। उद्वेजनीया भूतानां यथा व्यालमृगास्तथा॥
en: Those dreadful persons who are engaged in the destruction of living creatures never find protectors when they are in need. Such persons should always be molested and punished even as beasts of prey.

sa: कर्तव्यं पार्थिवेन्द्रेण तथैव भरतर्षभ। श्रोत्रियान् ब्राह्मणान् वृद्धान् नित्यमेवाभिपूजयेत्॥
en: Even this is what the foremost of all kings should do. Know this well, O chief of Bharata's race. The king should always adore with reverence all righteous Brahmanas possessed of Vedic learning.

sa: अलिग्रहणो नित्यः क्षेत्रज्ञे निर्गुणात्मकः। तस्मादलिङ्गः क्षेत्रज्ञः केवलं ज्ञानलक्षणः॥
en: The Kshetrajna which is eternal and is shorn of qualities about its essence, is incapable of being seized by symbols. Hence, the characteristic of the Kshetrajna, which is without symbols, is purely knowledge.

sa: परमं भेषजं ह्येतद् यज्ञानामेतदुत्तमम्। रसानामुत्तमं चैतत् फलानां चैतदुत्तमम्॥
en: Clarified butter is possessed of high medicinal virtues. It is a high requisite of Sacrifice. It is the best of all liquids. The merit a gift of clarified butter yields is very superior.

sa: ततः कदाचिन्निर्वेदान्निराकाराश्रितेन य। लोकतन्त्रं परित्यक्तं दुःखार्तेन भृशं मया॥
en: After all this one day, laden with sorrow, despair came upon me. I took refuge in the Formless. Suffering from great distress, I gave up the world with all its joys and sorrows.

sa: पितृलोकगताः सर्वे तारिताः पितरस्त्वया॥ अनागताश्च बहवः सुबहूनि युगान्युत।
en: The Pitris living in their own region, have all been rescued by them. Others, also, who have not attained to the position of Pitris, have equally been rescued by you for countless cycles.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा तानुपादाय सक्तून् प्रादाद् द्विजातये। ततस्तष्टोऽभवद् विप्रस्तस्य साधोर्महात्मनः॥८शा
en: Having said so to her, the Brahmana took her share of the barley and gave it to his guest. At this the guest became pleased with that great Brahmana gifted with great piety.

sa: दिव्यादिव्यप्रभावेन भारती गौः शुचिस्मिते। एतयोरन्तरं पश्य सूक्ष्मयोः स्यन्दमानयो॥
en: O you of beautiful smiles, Word is a cow, on account of her power which is both divine and not divine. See the distinction of these two subtle forms of Word that flow.

sa: सक्तुप्रस्थेन विजितो ब्रह्मलोकस्त्वयाक्षयः॥ विरजो ब्रह्मसदनं गच्छ विप्र यथासुखम्।
en: With this prastha of powdered barley you have conquered the eternal region of Brahman. Go you in happiness, O learned Brahmana, to the house of Brahman who is without the stain of darkness.

sa: नृत्यगीतपरा नार्यो दिव्यमाल्यविभूषिताः। उपतिष्ठन्ति देवेन्द्र तथा भूमिप्रदं दिवि॥
en: Beautiful ladies skilled in music and dancing and adorned with garlands of celestial flowers, approach, O king of the deities, the giver of earth as he comes to Heaven departing from the Earth.

sa: बिभ्रती कलशं रौकमं सर्वतीर्थजलोद्भवम्॥ गिरिस्रवाभिः सर्वाभिः पृष्ठतोऽनुगता शुभा।
en: She held a jar on her loins that was filled with the waters of every Tirtha, and was accompanied by the presiding goddess of all the mountain rivers. Those auspicious ladies followed her.

sa: वाजपेयेषु दशसु प्रादां तेष्वपि चाप्यहम्। शक्रतुल्यप्रभावाणामिज्यया विक्रमेण ह॥
en: In the ten great Vajapeya sacrifices that I celebrated I gave away a thousand heroes each gified with the power of Indra himself, judged by their prowess and the sacrifices they had celebrated.

sa: आगच्छद् ब्राह्मणः कश्चित् स्वर्गलोकादरिंदम ब्रह्मलोकाच्च दुर्धर्षः सोऽस्माभिः पूजितोऽभवत्।।१५
en: O chastiser of enemies, on one occasion, a Brahmana came to us from the celestial regions. Of irresistible energy, he came from the regions of the grandfather. He was duly respected by us.

sa: एवं सेन्द्रा वसिष्ठेन रक्षितास्त्रिदिवौकसः। ब्रह्मदत्तवराश्चैव हता दैत्या महात्मना।॥
en: Thus were the dwellers of Heaven, headed by Indra, rescued from great distress by Vasishtha. It was thus that those Danavas, who had received boons from Brahman, were killed by that great Rishi.

sa: कथमेष समुत्पन्नो रामः सत्यपराक्रमः। कथं ब्रह्मर्षिवंशोऽयं क्षत्रधर्मा व्यजायत॥
en: How was Rama born who was gifted with prowess incapable of being baffled? He belonged by birth to a family of twice born Rishis. How did he become a follower of Kshatriya practices?

sa: गूढधर्माश्रितो विद्वान् विज्ञानचरितं चरेत्। अमूढो मूढरूपेण चरेद् धर्ममदूषयन्॥
en: The learned man, living as a householder, should adopt that conduct which is conformable to true knowledge. Though undeluded, he should practise piety like one that is deluded, without finding fault without it.

sa: एवमुक्तः स राजा तु भगदत्तात्मजस्तदा। तथेत्येवाब्रवीद वाक्यं पाण्डवेनाभिनिर्जितः॥
en: Thus addressed by Arjuna the royal son of Bhagadatta, defeated by the son of Pandu, said, 'So be it.' that sacrifice of king Yudhishthira the just, for it takes place. on that day!

sa: आगच्छेया महाराज परां चैत्रीमुपस्थिताम्। यदाश्वमेधो भविता धर्मराजस्य धीमतः॥
en: When the day of full moon in the month of Chaitra comes, you shall O great king, go to that sacrifice of king Yudhishthira the just, for it takes place. on that day!

sa: पीयमाने तु सर्वस्मिंस्तोयेऽपि सलिलेश्वरः। सुहृद्धिर्भिक्षमाणोऽपि नैवामुञ्चत तां तदा।॥
en: When all the waters were thus drunk off, the Lord of that clement became very dispirited with all his friends and kinsfolk. For all that, he did not still give up Utathya's wife.

sa: त्रयोविंशे तु दिवसे प्राशेद् यस्त्वेकभोजनम्॥ सदा द्वादशमासांस्तु मिताहारो जितेन्द्रियः। वायोरुशनसश्चैव रुद्रलोकं च गच्छति॥ कामचारी कामगमः पूज्यमानोऽप्सरोगणैः।
en: That man who having fasted for twentytwo days, takes a single meal on the twenty third day, and acts thus for a full year, thus regulating his diet and keeping his senses under restraint acquires the regions of the wind God of Ushanas and of Rudras. Capable of going everywhere at will, and always roving at will, he is adored by various tribes of Apsaras. man

sa: तस्माज्ज्ञानेन शुद्धेन प्रशान्तात्मा जितेन्द्रियः। निर्ममो निरहङ्कारो मुच्यते सर्वपाप्मभिः॥
en: Hence, one who has a tranquil soul, who has subjugated his senses, who is freed from the sense of mineness, who is devoid of egoism, is freed from all sins by pure knowledge.

sa: संस्कृत: सर्वसंस्कारैस्तथैव ब्रह्मचर्यवान्। ग्रामान्निष्क्रम्य चारण्ये मुनिः प्रव्रजितो वसेत्॥
en: Cleansed by all purificatory rites and having lived as a Brahmacharin, one should next go out of his village and next live as an ascetic in the forest, having cast off (all attachments).

sa: स कैकेय्या गृहं श्रेष्ठं प्रविवेश महायशाः॥ पाण्डुराभ्रमिवाकाशं राहुयुक्तं निशाकरः। शुकबर्हिसमायुक्तं क्रौञ्चहंसरुतायुतम्॥ वादितरवसंघुष्टं कुब्जावामनिकायुतम्। लतागृहैश्चित्रगृहैश्चम्पकाशोकशोभितैः॥ दान्तराजतसौवर्णवेदिकाभिः समायुतम्। नित्यपुष्पफलैर्वृक्षैर्वापीभिरुपशोभितम्॥ दान्तराजतसौवर्णैः संवृतं परमासनैः। विविधैरन्नपानैश्च भक्ष्यैश्च विविधैरपि॥ उपपन्नं महाहश्च भूषणैत्रिदिवोपमम्।
en: Like to the moon entering the sky covered with white clouds and with Rähu present in it, that one of high fame entered the excellent apartment of Kaikeyi, having parrots and peacocks and Krauñcas and swans, resounding with the sounds of musical instruments, containing hump-backed and dwarfish women, graced with houses containing creepers, and pictures, and adorned adorned with aśokas and campakas, furnished with daises composed of ivory and silver and gold, and adorned with trees bearing flowers and fruits always, and tanks, having superb seats made of ivory, silver and gold; rich with various viands and drinks and edibles, with costly ornaments, and resembling heaven itself.

sa: ताश्चैवं पायसं प्राप्य नरेन्द्रस्योत्तमस्त्रियः। सम्मानं मेनिरे सर्वाः प्रहर्षोदितचेतसः॥
en: Thus the king dispensed the Pāyasa to each and all of his wives. And those foremost wives of the king, having received that Pāyasa, became exceedingly delighted, and considered themselves as highly honoured.

sa: ऋषीन् यक्षान् सगन्धर्वान् ब्राह्मणानसुरांस्तदा। अतिक्रामति दुर्धर्षो वरदानेन मोहितः॥
en: And blinded by the boon he has received, that irrepressible one intends to bring down the lord himself of the celestials, and the Yakşas, and the Gandharvas, and the Brahmanas, and the Asuras.

sa: भरतादेव रामस्य राज्यसाधारणाद्भयम्। तद्विचिन्त्य विषण्णास्मि भयं भीताद्वि जायते॥
en: From Bharata proceeds Rāma's fear concerning the kingdom to which both have an equal claim. Thinking of this, I am pressed down with sorrow, because fear proceeds from the person who fears much.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त: काकुत्स्थः प्रहस्य मदिरेक्षणाम्। इदं वचनमारेभे वक्तुं वाक्यविशारदः॥
en: Thus addressed, Kākutstha having charming eyes, well skilled in speech, with a smile, began to speak thus. with me, with a lean abdomen, will I devour up, along with this brother of yours.

sa: कामं त्विदं पुष्पितवृक्षषण्डं नानाविधैः पक्षिगणैरुपेतम्। मेकाकिनी सातिबिभेति भीरुः॥
en: Has she entered at her pleasure this forest filled with many flowery trees and diverse birds? But that is not possible too-she is timid and fear much to enter alone in this forest.

sa: पितुर्निदेशेन तु धर्मवत्सलो वनप्रवेशे कृतबुद्धिनिश्चयः। निवेदयस्वागमनं नृपाय मे॥
en: And making up his mind to go to the woods in accordance with the command of his father, Rāghava seeing Sumantra, said to him; “Do you inform the king of my arrival. to

sa: प्रभग्नधन्वा विरथो हताश्वो हतसारथिः। गदापाणिरवप्लुत्य तस्थौ भूमौ खरस्तदा॥
en: Then with his bow shattered, deprived of his car, (Khara) having his horses slain as well as his charioteer killed, taking a mace in his hand leaped to the ground, and stood there.

sa: मद्यप्रसक्तो भवतु स्त्रीष्वक्षेषु च नित्यशः। कामक्रोधाभिभूतश्च यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः॥
en: May he that had approved the exile of the noble one into the woods, be always addicted to wine, to women, and to dice; and may he be swayed by lust, anger, etc!

sa: विवर्णवदनं दृष्ट्वा तं प्रस्विनममर्षणम्। आह दुःखाभिसंतप्ता किमिदानीमिदं प्रभो॥
en: Finding him with face pale and perspiring, and incapable of containing grief within, Sītā sore distressed with sorrow addressed him, saying, Oh my lord, why do I perceive such a change in you?

sa: संग्रामे समुपोढे च शत्रुपक्षभयंकरे। पलायमानो बध्येत यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः॥
en: May that one that had approved the exile of the noble one into the woods, while flying from the engagement while it is waxing furious with the foe, come to be killed !

sa: भीमो धनंजयान्वेषी कस्तमाछेजिजीविषुः। को हि संजय भीमस्य स्थातुमुत्सहतेऽग्रतः॥
en: What persons desirous of his life with will venture to stand before that Bhima when he will proceed in search of Dhananjaya? ) Sanjaya, what person venture to stand in front of Bhima.

sa: श्रुतकर्मा ततः क्रुद्धश्चित्रसेनं चमूमुखे। नाराचेन सुतीक्ष्णेन मर्मदेशे समार्पयत्॥
en: Wrathful Shrutakarman, on the other hand, had struck down that Chitrasena, who was then standing at the head of his force, with a keen arrow in the most vital part of his body.

sa: विमुखं चैनमालोक्य माद्रीपुत्रौ महारथौ। ववर्षतुः पुनर्बाणैर्यथा मेघौ महागिरिम्॥
en: Seeing him turn away from the field, those two mighty car-warriors, the sons of Madri, again poured on him their arrowy showers, like two clouds drenching a mighty hill with showers of rain.

sa: अपराह्ने कथं युद्धमभवल्लोमहर्षणम्। तन्ममाचक्ष्व तत्त्वेन कुशलो ह्यसि संजय॥
en: How did take place the battle, that made the hairs to stand on points, in the afternoon? O Sanjaya, relate to me all these in detail; for you are an expert in this

sa: यच्छिक्षयानुद्धतः सन् रणे चरति सात्यकिः। महारथानुपक्रीडन् वृष्णीनां कीर्तिवर्धनः॥
en: That Satyaki, the enhancer of the glory of the Vrishnis, well-practised in the use of weapons and free from insolence, is thus careering in the midst of the fight, sporting with mighty car-warrior.

sa: चिकीर्षुर्मत्प्रियं पार्थ स यातः सव्यसाचिनः। पदवी दुर्गमां घोरामगम्यामकृतात्मभिः॥
en: O son of Pritha, desirous of doing me good, he has gone in search of Dhananjaya in an impossible track dreadful and in capable of being followed upon by warriors of inferior skill.

sa: असिभ्यां सम्प्रजह्राते परस्परमरिंदमौ। उभौ छिट्टैषिणो वीरावुभौ चित्रं ववल्गतुः॥
en: Those two subduer of foes began to smite each other with their swords and each was on the alert for finding the weakness of other. Both of those two heroes jumped up superbly.

sa: जयद्रथश्च हन्तव्यो लम्बते च दिवाकरः। श्रान्तश्चैष महाबाहुरल्पप्राणश्च साम्प्रतम्॥
en: It is also my (self-imposed) duty to slay Jayadratha. Yonder is the sun going down (the horizon). As regards the mighty-armed Satyaki he is fatigued and his stock of weapons is also exhausted.

sa: येन नागायुतप्राणो भीमसेनो महाबलः। मानुषेणैव युद्धेन तामवस्थां प्रवेशितः॥
en: It is by him that Bhimasena of mighty strength, endowed with the force of ten thousand elephants, was brought, through the tactics of warfare that are peculiar to man, into the same circumstance.

sa: ततो द्वैधीकृते सैन्ये द्रोणः सोमकपाण्डवान्। अभ्यद्रवत् सपाञ्चालान् दुर्योधनपुरोगमः॥
en: The host of the Kauravas having been divided into two parts, Diona, having Duryodhana in front of him, advanced (supported by one of this divisions) against the Somakas, the Panchalas and the Pandavas.

sa: हैडिम्बो भरतश्रेष्ठ शरैर्विव्याघ सप्तभिः। सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता राक्षसेन्द्रो महाबलः॥
en: And the former (the son of Hidimba) then pierced the latter with seven shafts. O king that foremost of the Rakshasas, endued with might viz., Alambusha, being pierced deeply by his powerful antagonist.

sa: सीमन्तमिव कुर्वाणा नभसः पावकप्रभा। अदृश्यतापतन्ती सा शक्रमुक्ता यथाशनिः॥
en: Sparkling like the tongues of fire, that mace flew towards ourselves dividing the welkin like the line that parts the tresses of woman and with the impetuosity of the thunder hurled by Shakra.

sa: तथा दुर्योधनसुतस्तरस्वी युद्धदुर्मदः। वर्तमानः पितुः शास्त्रे सौभद्रेण निपातितः॥
en: So also the son of Duryodhana, of immense activity and incapable of being vanquished in battle and resting over obedient under the command of his father, was killed by the son of Subhadra.

sa: तं प्रपद्य महात्मानं भूतिमश्नाम्यनुत्तमाम्॥ परमेश परेशेश तिर्यगीश नरेश्वर।
en: By taking refuge with you, O high-souled one, I shall enjoy the most excellent prosperity. O Supreme God, O god of the highest gods, O lord of the creation, O lord of men.

sa: सौबलस्तु ततस्तस्य शरांश्चिक्षेप वीर्यवान्। तानापतत एवाशु चिच्छेद परमासिना॥
en: Thereupon the son of Subala, who was possessed of immense prowess, shot innumerable arrows at him (his antagonist), who, again, immediately severed them by means of his sword, that were directed against him.

sa: तस्य क्रुद्धस्य राजेन्द्र वपुर्दीप्तमदृश्यत। अन्तकस्येव भूतानि जिहीर्षोः कालपर्यये॥
en: Inflamed as he was with rage, his body, O monarch, appeared to burn like that of the Destroyer himself when at the expiration of a Yuga, he engages himself in slaughtering created beings.

sa: कर्णो ह्यभ्यधिकः पार्थादस्त्रैरेव नरर्षभः। भवानभ्यधिकः कृष्णादश्वज्ञाने बले तथा॥
