en: O foremost of persons, Karna is, indeed, far superior to the son of Pritha respecting the management of weapons; and you, too, are superior to Krishna both in the horse-lore and physical power.

sa: नाराचोऽभ्यपतत् कर्ण तूर्ण गाण्डीवचोदितः। तमन्तरिक्षे नाराचं द्रौणिश्चिच्छेद पत्रिणा॥
en: That Naracha shot form the Gandiva, flew through the sky towards Karna in all quickness. Then the son of Drona cut-off that Naracha as it coursed through the sky, with a singed arrows.

sa: अभीषाहाः कवचिनः प्रहरन्तो रणोत्कटाः। शिवयश्च रथोदाराः कालिङ्गसहिता हताः॥
en: The Abhishaha troops, the mighty smiters of foes, who are all clad in armour and most fierce in battle, as also the powerful carwarriors, the Shivi soldiers, all were slain with the Kalingas.

sa: अथ हंसाः समुद्रान्ते कदाचिदतिपातिनः॥ गरुडस्य गतौ तुल्याश्चक्राङ्गा हृष्टचेतसः।
en: It so happened that once on a time several cheerful swans, quick-coursing, capable of going every where at will, equal to Garuda in fight and speed, came to that side of the ocean.

sa: पुनरेव च विव्याध षभिरष्टाभिरेव च। मर्मखमरविक्रान्तः सूतपुत्रं तनुत्यजम्॥
en: Then once more that one of prowess resembling that of the immortals, pierced that reckless son of a Suta in his vital limbs with two sets of arrows numbering six and eight respectively.

sa: ततः पुनः समाजग्मुरभीताः कुरुपाण्डवाः। भीमसेनमुखाः पार्थाः सूतपुत्रमुखा वयम्॥
en: Then once more both the Kurus and the Pandavas fearlessly came face to face (for an encounter). The sons of Pritha were headed by Bhimasena; and we were headed by the son Suta.

sa: तत्रैव दुःशासनममर्षणम्। पूरयित्वाञ्जलिं भूयो रुधिरस्योगनिःस्वनः॥ शृण्वतां लोकवीराणामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।
en: Bhimasena, then after thus killing the vengeful Dushasana and holding a full draught of his blood in his hands in the presence of those great and mighty warriors, loudly spoke the following words-

sa: तारकाक्षसुतो वीरो हरिर्नाम महाबलः॥ तपस्तेपे परमकं येनातुष्यत् पितामाहः।
en: The heroic and the most powerful son of Tarakaksha, who was known by the name of Hari, practised the most severe devotion, in consequence of which the Grandsire became highly satisfied with him.

sa: तेषां रथाश्वनागाश्च प्रवराचोग्रपत्तयः। नानावाद्यधरैर्हष्टा नृत्यन्ति च हसन्ति च॥
en: Their car-warriors, cavalry and elephantforce, that all belonged to the superior class, as well as the terrible-looking infantry, were highly gratified to hear the harmonious sound of several instruments and began to laugh.

sa: तत्किल्बिषं स्मरे धर्म नान्यत्पापमहं स्मरे। तन्मे सहस्रममितं कस्मान्नेहाजयत्तपः॥
en: O Dharma, I remember this sin of mine; I cannot remember any other. I have since practised asceticism thousand fold. Has not that one sin of mine been expitiated by my great asceticism?

sa: हरिष्यामि विनिक्षिप्तं सोममित्यनुभाष्य तम्। आजगाम ततस्तूर्णं सुपर्णो मातुरन्तिकम्॥
en: "I shall take away the Soma when you will place it down." Having said this he bade farewell to Garuda, And Suparna (Garuda) went to the presence of his mother with great speed.

sa: धर्मज्ञानां मुख्यतमस्तपस्वी संशितब्रतः। आसीन्महर्षिः श्रुतवान् मन्दपाल इति श्रुतः॥
en: O king, there was a great Rishi, the foremost of all virtuous men, known by the name of Mandapala. He was learned in all the Shastras and devoted to asceticism and rigid VOWS.

sa: अपां पतिरथोवाच ममाप्यंशो भवेत्ततः। सोढाऽस्मि विपुलं मर्द मन्दरभ्रमणादिति॥
en: The ocean replied, “Be it so, as I shall get a share of it. I am quite able to bear the great agitation arising out of the churning of my water by Mandara.

sa: कृत्रिमं भासमारोप्य वृक्षाग्रे शिल्पिभिः कृतम्। अविज्ञातं कुमाराणां लक्ष्यभूतमुपादिशत्॥
en: He caused in artificial bird made by an artisan to be placed on the top of a tree without the knowledge of the princes for the purpose of using it as the target.

sa: सौतिरुवाच तस्य कण्ठमनुप्राप्तो ब्राह्मणः सह भार्यया। दहन्दीप्त इवाङ्गारस्तमुवाचन्तरिक्षगः॥
en: Sauti said : A Brahmana with his wife had entered into his throat and he began to burn the bird's throat like a flaming piece of charcoal. The great bird addressed him thus,

sa: तादृशं तपसा युक्तं प्रदीप्तमिव पावकम्। कथमस्मद्विधा नारी जितेन्द्रियमभिस्पृशेत्॥
en: How can a woman (like my humble self) touch such a man who is full of ascetic virtues, who is as blazing as the blazing fire and who has completely controlled his passions.

sa: ततः स गर्भो निवसत्कुक्षौ भृगुकुलोद्वह। रोषान्मातुश्च्युतः कुक्षेश्च्यवनस्तेन सोऽभवत्॥
en: The child, of Bhrigu, who was in her womb, was very much enraged at this violence and he dropped down from his mother's womb, For this reason he got the name as Chyavana.

sa: इत्युक्तः कौरवो राजा वासवेन महात्मना॥ उवाच कुन्ती धर्मात्मा देवराजवचः स्मरन्। उदर्कस्तव कल्याणि तुष्टो देवगणेश्वरः॥ दातुमिच्छति ते पुत्रं यथा संकल्पितं त्वया। अतिमानुषकर्माणं यशस्विनीमरिंदमम्॥ नीतिमन्तं महात्मानमादित्यसतेजसम्। दुराधर्ष क्रियावन्तमतीवाद्भुतदर्शनम्॥
en: Having been thus addressed by the illustrious Indra, the virtuous Kuru king (Pandu), remembering the words of the king of the celestials said to Kunti, O fortunate one, your vow has been successful. The king of the celestials is gratified. He is willing to give you a son such as you desire to have (who will be) of superior human achievements and great fame (how will be) a chastiser of enemies and a greatly wise man, (who will possess) a great son, (who will be) invincible battle, (who will be) as effulgent as the sun (who will be) very handsome and endued with all the Kshatriya splendour.

sa: कृतोऽयं कुलसंकल्पः क्षत्रियैर्वसुधाधिप। निदेशवाग्भिस्तत् ते ह विदितं भरतर्षभ॥
en: O lord of earth, O best of the Bharata race, you are aware of the rules that those Kshatriyas established amongst their order, guided by the traditions (coming down from generations to generations).

sa: सोऽन्वेषमाणः कौन्तेयं पाञ्चाल्यो जनमेजय। दृढं धनुरनानम्यं कारयामास भारत॥
en: O Janamejaya, O descendant of Bharata, thinking of the son of Kunti (Arjuna), the Panchala king caused a very stiff bow to be made incapable of being bent by any man except Arjuna.

sa: वेदानधिजगे साङ्गान् वसिष्ठादेष वीर्यवान्। कृतास्त्रः परमेष्वासो देवराजसमो युधि॥
en: This greatly energetic boy has studied with Vasistha all the Vedas with their Angas. He is skillful in all the weapons, he is a great bowman, he is like Indra himself in battle.

sa: धन्विनां नृपशार्दूल यः सर्वास्त्रवित्तमः। महाकीर्तिर्महातेजा: स जज्ञे मनुजेश्वर॥
en: O best of kings, he was a hero of great achievements and the best of all those that were learned in the ways of using arms. He was most illustrious and most powerful.

sa: याचतस्त्वं हि दुहिता स्तुवतः प्रतिगृह्णतः। सुताहं स्तूयमानस्य ददतोऽप्रतिगृह्णतः॥ आदुन्वस्व विदुन्वस्व दुह्य कुष्यस्व याचकि। अनायुधा सायुधाया रिक्ता क्षुभ्यसि भिक्षुकि। लप्स्यसे प्रतियोद्धारं न हि त्वां गणयाम्यहम्॥
en: You are the daughter of a man who begs and I am the daughter of one who bestows alms. your father chants praises of others and my father's praises are chanted. Your father lives on alms, my father bestows them. O beggar's girl, you are free to strike your breast, to use harsh words, to vow enmity to me and to give way to your wrath. O beggarly woman, you weep in vain. You cannot harm me, though I can harm you. You desire to quarrel with me, but I do not at all consider you as my equal.

sa: खट्वाङ्गनाभागदिलीपकल्प ययातिमांधातृसमप्रभाव। आदित्यतेजः प्रतिमानतेजा भीष्मो यथा राजसि सुव्रतस्त्वम्॥
en: You are like Khatvanga, Nabhaga and Dilipa. You are like Yayati and Mandhata in prowess. You are equal to the sun in splendour. O royal sage of excellent vows, you are like Bhishma.

sa: शिरोरुहेषु जग्राह माल्यवत्सु धनंजयः। भ्रातृन् प्रति चकर्षाथ सोऽस्त्रपातादचेतसम्॥
en: But Dhananjaya sized him by the hair of his head which was adorned with garlands of flowers. He dragged towards his brother that (Gandharva), insonsible in consequence of (being wounded by) the weapon.

sa: अर्थेप्सुता परं दुःखमर्थप्राप्तौ ततोऽधिकम्। जातस्नेहस्य चार्थेषु विप्रयोगे महत्तरम्॥
en: Great misery is for those that desire wealth, greater for him who has (already) acquired it. Great affection is engendered on the acquired wealth; and when it goes away, the misery is great.

sa: श्रुत्वा पुरुषशार्दूलो विसंज्ञो बाष्पलोचनः। स मुहूर्तमिवासंज्ञो विनिःश्वस्य मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: And remaining stunned for some time and regaining his sense afterwards he began to breathe hard out of excess of surprise. He heard in that song, of pasi events as things passing on.

sa: तत:प्रभृति लोकेस्मिन्पूज्यः सर्वधनुष्मताम्। आदित्य इव दुष्प्रेक्ष्यः समरेष्वपि चाभवत्॥
en: From that day he was very much respected by all men as a great bowman. Like the sun he appeared in the field of battle and was difficult to be beheld by enemies.

sa: तौ त दीर्पण कालेन तपोयुक्तौ बभूवतुः। क्षुत्पिपासापरिश्रान्तौ जटावल्कलधारिणौ।
en: Exhausted with hunger and thirst with matted locks on their heads and attired in barks of trees, They performed penances for a very long time till at last they received sufficient ascetic merits.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच सम्पूज्याथाभ्यनुज्ञातो महर्षेर्वचनात् परम्। प्रत्युवाचानुपूर्येण धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Vaishampayana said At the end on the Brahmarshi (Narada's) words, Dharamaraja Yudhishthira's duly worshipped him; and then having been commanded by him he replied in detail (to the questions asked by the Rishi).

sa: एकैकश्चापि पुरुषस्तत् प्रयच्छति भोजनम्। स वारो बहुभिर्वर्भवत्यसुकरो नरैः॥
en: One after another all (men of this town) send him his food. Though it is very difficult to be kept, yet the turn comes to a particular family at intervals of many years.

sa: दृष्टास्माभिः प्ररुदिता दृढं शोकपरायणा। अनर्हा दुःखशोकाभ्यामेका दीना अनाथवत्॥
en: We saw her alone crying aloud being overwhelmed with sorrow and grief as if she had none to look after her. A damsel like her should not be subject to such a condition.

sa: अनारभन्तो निघ्नन्तो महास्त्रैः शत्रुघातिभिः। न हन्यामो वयं तस्य त्रिभिर्वर्षशतैर्बलम्॥
en: And we came to the conclusion that even if we continually strike at our enemy with weapons capable of killing the foe, we shall not be able to do any thing of him in three hundred years.

sa: ययातिरुवाच एकदेहोद्भवा वर्णाश्चत्वारोऽपि वराङ्गने। पृथग्धर्माः पृथक्छौचास्तेषां तु ब्राह्मणो वरः॥
en: Yayati said : O beautiful lady, the four orders have no doubt sprung from one body. But they have different duties and virtues, which are not the same (for every order.) The Brahmanas are superior to all.

sa: स्वधर्मे रेमिरे वर्णा दैवे कर्मणि नि:स्पृहाः। तमाश्रित्य महीपालमासंश्चैवाकुतो भयाः॥
en: Men of all the four castes took pleasure in doing their respective duties and they performed all acts without the desire of gaining fruits. O protector of the world, depending upon him, his subjects felt no fear.

sa: राजभिर्यद् यथा कार्य पुरा वैतन्न संशयः। यथान्यायोपनीतार्थं कृतं हेतुमदर्थवत्॥
en: There is no doubt that the acts properly performed by the kings of the olden days should be regarded as having borne proper fruit and having been undertaken from sound motive for the attainment of proper objects.

sa: स्वप्नानतेऽप्यज्रि चैवाह हरः सिन्धुपतेः सुतम्। वरं वृणीष्व प्रीतोऽस्मि जयद्रथकिमिच्छसि।॥
en: The god Hara revealing himself in a dream to the son of the ruler of the Sindhus, addressed ever him thus "Ask the boon you like; I am pleased with you, O Jayadratha, what do you desire?"

sa: सर्वे ब्रह्मविदः शूराः सर्वे सुचरितव्रताः। सर्वे कामकृतश्चैव सर्वे चाहवलक्षणाः॥
en: All of them were versed in the Vedas, and were powerful warriors, and all of them had always ably observed their vows, and all could do as they pleased, and all showed signs of having (previously) fought.

sa: अम्बोवाच भगवशरणं त्वाद्य प्रपन्नाऽस्मि महाव्रतम्। शोकपङ्कार्णवान्मग्नां घोरादुद्धर मां विभो॥
en: Amba said My lord, I be take myself now to your refuge for you are of great vows, Tell me, my lord, who am fallen into the mire of grief and liberate me from the heavy calamity.

sa: न चान्यपूर्वा राजेन्द्र त्वामहं समुपस्थिता। सत्यं ब्रवीमि शाल्वैतत् सत्येनात्मानमालभे॥
en: O chief among kings, I do not come to you as one who has before been ravished by another. I am speaking the truth, O lord of the Shalvas, I swear by my soul and by truth.

sa: देवासुरा नरा यक्षा गन्धर्वोरगपक्षिणः॥ विप्रास्तत्रागताश्चासन् वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः। ब्राह्मणा ऋषयश्चापि नासंस्तत्राविपश्चितः॥
en: Gods, Asuras, men, Jakshas, Gandharvas, snakes, birds and many Vipras, learned in the Vedas and their auxiliaries, came at this sacrifices. Among the Brahmanas and the sages who came there, there was none who was not learned.

sa: तथा स समरश्लाघी मन्तव्यो रथसत्तमः। काश्यः परमशीघ्रास्त्रः श्लाघनीयो नरोत्तमः॥
en: So should also that best among carwarriors, who is proud of his velour in battle should be thought by you. That best among men Kashya is endued with extreme quickness of hand and is worthy of praise.

sa: उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते। गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येव योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते॥
en: He, who remains all unconcerned, being not shaken by the three qualities who sits and moves not, thinking that it is the qualities and not he, who is engaged in their functions, has transcended the three qualities.

sa: ततस्ते पार्थिवाः सर्वे प्रगृहीतशरासनाः। सहसैन्याः समापेतुः पुत्रस्य तव शासनात्॥ युधिष्ठिरेण चादिष्टाः पार्थिवास्ते सहस्रशः। विनदन्तः समापेतुः पुत्रस्य तव वाहिनीम्॥ उभयोः सेनयोस्तीव्रः सैन्यानां स समागमः। अन्तर्धीयत चादित्यः सैन्येन रजसाऽऽवृतः॥
en: Under the command of your son, they rushed upon the enemy at the head of their respective troops. Fearful was the uproar made by the elephants and horses of the kings rushing to the charge, mingled with the lionlike shouts of the warriors and the din made by the sounds of conchs and drums. The uproar of that ocean (the battle field), which had arrows for its crocodiles, bows for its snakes, swords for its tortoises and the toward leaps of the warriors for its tempest, looked like a real ocean agitated by a tempest. Thousands of kings commanded by Yudhishthira attacked the ranks of your son with their respective troops.

sa: शूरो वीरः कृतार्थश्च प्रताप्यारीन् सहस्रशः। अभिमन्युर्गतो वीरः पृतनाभिमुखो हतः॥
en: As regards Abhimanyu, he was courageous and brave. He has fulfilled the mission of his life; for, the brave son of Subhadra having scorched his enemies by thousands, had passed away, falling on the field of battle.

sa: द्रोणस्यासीदविरतो गृहे तं न शृणोम्यहम्। नानादेशसमुत्थानां गीतानां योऽभवत् स्वनः॥
en: The melody of songs that used to be sang in the various parts of the field and that used to be mingled with the sound of musical instruments, alas, that sound could not be heard this day.

sa: अभज्यत महाराज न च द्वौ सह धावतः। आविद्धनरनागाश्वं पतितध्वजकूबरम्॥
en: O great king, that great army was so completely routed that no two persons were seen together; cars, elephants, and horses were pierced all over their bodies, and the standards and arrows were strewn over the field.

sa: लोहाभिसारो निर्वृत्तः कुरुक्षेत्रमकर्दमम्। पुष्टास्तेऽश्वा भृता योधाः श्वो युद्ध्यस्व सकेशवः॥९३।
en: The deities, presiding over each weapon, have now been invoked. Kurukshetra is now free from mud, your horses are fat and sleek, your soldiers have been paid their dues, therefore do you fight, along with Keshava tomorrow.

sa: लोहाभिसारो निर्वृत्तः कुरुक्षेत्रमकर्दमम्। समः पन्था भृतास्तेऽश्वाः श्वो युध्यस्व सकेशवः॥
en: The deities, presiding over each weapon, have now been invoked. Kurukshetra is now free from mud, your horses are fat and sleek, your soldiers have been paid their dies, therefore do you fight, along with Keshava tomorrow.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच बालमत्यन्तसुखिनं स्वबाहुबलदर्पितम्। युद्धेषु कुशलं वीरं कुलपुत्रं तनुत्यजम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said When that heroic Abhimanyu, that veritable child brought up in great luxury, proud of the strength of his arms, expert in the art of fighting, of noble blood, ready to sacrifice his life in battle.

sa: यदृच्छालाभसंतुष्टो द्वन्द्वातीतो विमत्सरः। समः सिद्धावसिद्धौ च कृत्वाऽपि न निबध्यते॥
en: Being contended with what is earned spontaneously, rising superior to the pairs of opposites, being free from all jealousy, (such a man), being equable in success or failures, is not fettered by actions, although he performs actions.

sa: एवमादि मया सृष्टं पृथिव्यां त्वत्प्रसादजम्। पद्मनाभ विशालाक्ष कृष्ण दुःखप्रणाशन॥
en: All these have been created by me in the first instance, on earth, through your grace. O you that have the lotus springing from your navel, O you of expanded eyes, O Krishna,O soother of all afflictions.

sa: अस्ति वास्यान्तरं किंचित् कुमारस्याथ पश्यत। अण्वष्यस्यान्तरं ह्यद्य चरतः सर्वतोदिशम्॥
en: "With all your watchfulness, have you been able to detect any weakness in this youthful prince? He is careering in all directions; yet has any of you been able to find out any laches in the prince?

sa: तस्य रोषान्महाराज खेभ्योऽग्निरुदतिष्ठत। तेन सर्वा दिशो व्याप्ताः सान्तर्देशा दिधक्षता॥
en: (Then he waxed wroth) and inconsequence of that wrath then, a fire sprang out from the skies. That fire spread in all the quarters of heaven and it began to consume all the regions of the universe.

sa: मानुषं लोकमातिष्ठ वासुदेव इति श्रुतः। असुराणां वधार्थाय सम्भवस्व महीतले॥
en: To take his birth in the world of men and to be known as the son of Vasudeva (I entreated him saying): "For slaughtering the Asuras, do you take your birth on the face of the earth.

sa: पुष्पाह्वयं नाम विराजमानं रत्नप्रभाभिश्च विघूर्णमानम्। वेश्मोत्तमानामपि चोञ्चमानं. महाकपिस्तत्र महाविमानम्॥
en: And the mighty monkey beheld there the great chariot going after the name of Pushpa, appearing beautiful, wheeling round in the splendour of the gems—which had surpassed cven the cars pertaining to the abodes of the celestials.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच अहं वै कुरुभिर्योत्स्याम्यवजेष्यामि ते पशून्॥ संकल्पपक्षविक्षेपं बाहुप्राकारतोरणम्।
en: Arjuna said I will fight with the Kurus and bring back your animals. Guarded by me the top of this car shall be like a citadel to you; these my arms shall be like ramparts and gates.

sa: क्षत्रियेण हि हन्तव्यः क्षत्रियो लोभमास्थितः। अक्षत्रियो वा दाशार्ह स्वधर्ममनुतिष्ठता।॥
en: A Kshatriya who is avaricious ought to be killed by a Kshatriya who is desirous of proving true to his our religion; and even if the covetous man is not a Kshatriya he ought to be slain.

sa: महादेवोऽपि पार्थेन श्रूयते युधि तोषितः। किरातवेषप्रच्छन्नो गिरौ हिमवति प्रभुः॥
en: O Kauravas, I do not see here any one who can withstand him in battle. It is heard, that on the mountain Himavan, the lord Mahadeva too, disguised as a hunter, was pleased by Partha in battle.

sa: वीरसूर्वीरपत्नी त्वं सर्वैः समुदिता गुणैः। सुखदुःखे महाप्राज्ञे त्वादृशी सोढुमर्हति॥
en: Yourself the wife of a hero, you have produced heroes; you are endued with all the virtues; it is fitting, of great wisdom as you are, that you should bear patiently happiness and misery like the Partha's.

sa: किं पुनर्धार्तराष्ट्राणां लुब्धानां पापचेतसाम्। मयाऽपि हि महाबाहो त्वत्प्रियार्थं महाहवे॥
en: What to speak of those sons of Dhritarashtra of wicked heart who are acting from covetousness. By me too, O you of long arms, has been taken great pains for your benefit in the forth-coming great war.

sa: जातोऽसि भारते वंशे सर्वपार्थिवपूजिते। गच्छ युद्धस्व धर्मेण क्षात्रेण पुरुषर्षभा॥
en: You are born in the race of Bharata, honored by all rulers of the earth; O you best among men, go and fight in strict accordance with the rules of honour and those of the military class."

sa: यदा द्रष्टा भीमसेनेन नागान् निपातितान् गिरिकूटप्रकाशान्। स्तदा युद्धं धार्तराष्ट्रोऽन्वतप्स्यत्॥
en: When the son of Dhritarashtra sees elephants felled to the ground by Bhimasena looking like the summits of mountains with their pierced pot-like heads pouring blood like pots pouring water, then will he repent for the war.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच जानाम्येतां महाराज धार्तराष्ट्रस्य पापताम्। अवाच्यास्तु भविष्यामः सर्वलोके महीक्षिताम्॥
en: The blessed God said I know the vicious nature, O great king, of that son of Dhritarashtra; but (by doing as I say) shall we not be spoken ill of in all these worlds in the universe.

sa: तानाशुगैरापततोऽहमाशु निवार्य हन्तुं खगमान् ख एव। स्ततोऽन्तरिक्षे निनदो बभूव॥
en: As the weapons came down through the sky I speedily stopped them with my swift arrows. I cut them off into two or three pieces before they could reachine. Thereupon a great uproar rose in the sky.

sa: विदितं मे महाप्राज्ञ भोजेष्वेवासमञ्जसम्। पुत्रं संत्यक्तवान् पूर्वं पौराणां हितकाम्यया॥
en: O greatly wise one, it is known to you, that amongst the Bhojas, (there is a custom) of abandoning a son who is unworthy of there race, for (the sake of the general) good of the people.

sa: शक्रस्य हस्ताद् दयितं वज्रमस्त्रं च दुःसहम्। अशनीश्च महानादा मेघबर्हिणलक्षणाः॥
en: He received from the hands of Shakra (Indra) his favourite Vajra (thunder) weapon of irresistible force and also those lightning of tremendous roars, fashes of which bespoken (by the appearance) of clouds and (the dancing) of peacocks.

sa: चत्वार एकतो वेदाः साङ्गोपाङ्गाः सविस्तराः। स्वधीता मनुजव्याघ्र सत्यमेकं किलैकतः॥
en: O foremost of men! surely the performance of one single promise on one side, weighs equal with the study of the four Vedas in all their extent and the Angas and Upangas taken together, on the other.

sa: महाबलान् पर्वतकूटमात्रान् विषाणिनः पश्य गजान् नरेन्द्र। नेशे बलस्येति चरेदधर्मम्॥
en: Behold, O king, O foremost of men, (even) the powerful elephants, having tusks as huge as the mountain tops, do not pass by the laws of the Creator. Therefore none should act unrighteously, thinking, 'I am powerful.'

sa: सुरक्षितं सुगुप्तं च सर्वायुधसमन्वितम्। तत् पुरं भरतश्रेष्ठ यथेन्द्रभवनं तथा॥
en: And in consequence of the preparations made, our city became then more prepared than ever to meet the enemy. O best of the Bharata race, in consequence of all this, it looked like the abode of Indra.

sa: न हि गाण्डीवमुक्तानां शराणां गार्धवाससाम्। स्पर्शमाशीविषाभानां मर्त्यः कश्चन संसहेत्॥
en: There is no mortal who can withstand the touch of the arrows which are equipped with the feathers of vulture and which are like the snakes of virulent poison when these are shot from the Gandiva (bow).

sa: ततस्तस्यैव शाखायां न्यग्रोधस्य विशाम्पते। आस्ते मनुजशार्दूल कृत्स्नमादाय वै जगत्॥
en: O king, foremost of men, I then saw seated on the branch of the banian tree that immeasurably effulgent being in the form of a boy, with the mark of Srivatsa, who had swallowed up the universe.

sa: गौतमी नाम कौन्तेय स्थविरा शमसंयुता। सर्पण दष्टं स्वं पुत्रमपश्यद्गतचेतनम्॥
en: There was, O son of Kunti, an old lady named Gautami, who was endued with great patience and peace of mind. One day she found her son dead on account of having been bitten by a serpent.

sa: आर्द्रपादस्तु भुञ्जीत नार्द्रपादस्तु संविशेत्॥ आर्द्रपादस्तु भुजानो वर्षाणां जीवते शतम्।
en: One should wash his feet before sitting to one's meals. One should never sit or lie down for slecp with wet feet. One who sits to his meals after having washed his feet, lives for a century.

sa: समुन्त्रिते सुविक्रान्ते सुकृते सुविचारिते। सिध्यन्त्यर्था महाबाहो दैवं चात्र प्रदक्षिणम्॥
en: But, O mighty-armed hero, whatever is performed with (due) deliberation, with welldirected prowess, with all (necessary) appliances and with much previous thought, is (always) seen to be successful (at the end.) The celestials themselves favour such acts.

sa: तपसा वालखिल्यानां मम संकल्पजौ तथा। भविष्यतो महाभागौ पुत्रौ त्रैलोक्यपूजितौ॥
en: Owing to the penances of the Valakhilyas and by virtue of the desire with which I had began my sacrifice, those sons will be of exceeding good fortune and they will be worshipped by the three worlds.

sa: सर्वभूतकरो यस्मात् सर्वभूतपतिर्हरः। सर्वभूतान्तरात्मा च तेन त्वं न निमन्त्रितः॥
en: Since you, O Rudra, are the Creator of all creatures, since, O Hara, you are the Master of all creatures, and since you are the indwelling spirit of all creatures, therefore, you were not invited by me.

sa: सोऽयं चतुर्णामेतेषामाश्रमाणां दुराचरः। तं चराद्य विधि पार्थ दुश्चरं दुर्बलेन्द्रियैः
en: The life of a householder is the inost difficult of all the four modes of life. Do you practise that mode of life then, O Partha, which is difficult of being practised by persons of uncontrolled senses.

sa: मान्युवाच अहमेवानुयास्यामि भर्तारमपलायिनम्। न हि तृप्तास्मि कामानां ज्येष्ठा मामनुमन्यताम्॥
en: Madri said: I am still clasping our lord and here not allowed him to go away. Therefore, I shall follow him. I am not as yet satiated you are my eldest sister, give me permission (to go).

sa: निर्वेदमहमासाद्य द्रव्यनाशाद् यदृच्छया। निर्वृत्तिं परमां प्राप्य नाद्य कामान् विचिन्तये॥
en: I who was disappointed, at first, at the loss of my property, have now attained to the high state of perfect freedom from attachments. At this moment I no longer think of you and your train. I

sa: शिखण्डी नहुषो बभ्रुर्दिवःस्पृक् त्वं पुनर्वसुः। सुबभू रुक्मयज्ञश्च सुषेणो दुन्दुभिस्तथा॥
en: You are Shikhandin, you are Nahusha, and you are Babhru. You are the constellation Punarvasu residing in the sky. You are of iwany colour, you are the sacrifice of Uktha, you are Sushena, you are the drum.

sa: दर्शयस्व नरव्याघ्र शाधि मामसुखान्विताम्। कृपणां चाथ करुणं विलपन्ती नरेश्वर॥
en: I shall abstain from every luxury, being ever desirous of seeing you. O best of men, show yourself to me. O king of men, O lord, command your wretched and bitterly weeping wife, plunged in great misery.

sa: यथा सुरपतिः शक्रस्त्रासयामास दानवान्। तथैव समरे राजा द्रावयामास पाण्डवान्॥
en: As the lord of the celestial (Indra) waxing worth had struck terror into the hearts of the Danavas, so did also the ruler of the Pragjyotishas, O king, in that battle frighten and crush the Pandava troops.

sa: तं व्यालनानाविधगूढसारं गजाश्वपादातरथौघपक्षम्। व्यूहं महामेघसमं महात्मा ददर्श दूरात् कपिराजकेतुः॥
en: With various kinds of forces possessing great strength and also with innumerable elephants, horses and foot soldiers and carwarriors, the Vyuha invade by the apebannered hero (Arjuna) looked from the distance like a great mass of clouds.

sa: भुक्त्वा चान्नं तथैव त्रिर्द्धिः पुनः परिमार्जयेत्॥ प्राङ्मुखो नित्यमश्रीयाद् वाग्यतोऽन्नमकुत्सयन्।
en: Having finished his meals, one should wash his mouth thrice with water and twice again. One should eat, with face turned east wards, his food, controlling speech the while and without censuring the food that is caten.

sa: प्रस्थाप्य माद्रीसुतमाजमीढः शोकार्दितस्तैः सहितः सुहृद्धिः। रोरूयमाणः प्रययौ सुतानामायोधनं भूतगणानुकीर्णम्॥
en: Having sent the son of Madri, Yudhishthira, moved by grief, proceeded, with tearful eyes and accompanied by his friends to the field on which his sons had fought and which was filled with various kinds of creatures.

sa: प्रागिदं वचनं प्रोक्तमतः प्राग्वचनं विदुः। व्यवहारस्य चाख्यानद् व्यवहार इहोच्यते॥
en: And because these words were spoken first, therefore, they are known as the first. And since Punishment which stops the misappropriation of other people's wealth, therefore, Punishment has come to be called by the name of Vyavahara.

sa: न प्राणहेतोर्न भयान्न विषादाद् विशाम्पते। इदमम्भः प्रविष्टोऽस्मि श्रमात् त्विदमनुष्ठितम्॥
en: It was not for the sake of saving my life, it was not for fear, it was not from grief, O king, that I entered this lake. It was only out of fatigue that I did so.

sa: गणमुख्यैस्तु सम्भूय कार्यं गणहितं मिथः! पृथग्गणस्य भिन्नस्य विततस्य ततोऽन्यथा॥
en: Acting jointly with the leaders, the king, should do what is for the behoof of the whole order. When, however, the aristocracy are divided and disunited and have no leaders, other courses of action should be followed,

sa: इदं दुःखं महत् कष्टं पापीय इति नष्टनन्। प्रतिध्वस्तमुखः पूतिरमात्याननुशोचयन्॥
en: In disease, people hear one crying,-What। sorrow! How painful! I must be a great sinner! : With face emaciated and bad smell coming out of his body and clothes, the sick man drowns his relatives into grief.

sa: वरदानात् पितुः कामं छन्दमृत्युरसि प्रभो। शान्तनोधर्मनित्यस्य न त्वेतन्मम कारणम्॥
en: By virtue of the boon granted to you by your father, the righteous Shantanu, your death, O powerful hero, depends on your own will. I myself have not that merit for which you have obtained this boons.

sa: आवर्तयति भूयिष्ठं तदेव ह्यनुपालितम्॥ कुलीना देशजाः प्राज्ञा रूपवन्तो बहुश्रुताः।
en: Those who are of high descent, who. are born in your kingdom, who have wisdom, beauty, great learning, and dignity of conduct, and who are, besides, devoted to you, should be employed as officers of your army.

sa: यस्मिन्न नश्यन्ति गुणाः कौन्तेय पुरुषे सदा। आश्रमस्थं तमप्याहुनरश्रेष्ठं युधिष्ठिर॥
en: That king, O son of Kunti, who has all the virtues, that foremost of men, O Yudhishthira, is said by the learned to be a person who follows the Vanaprastha and all the other modes of life.

sa: असंशयं दैवपरः क्षिप्रमेव विनश्यति। याजयैनं विश्वजिता सर्वस्वेन वियुज्य तम्॥
en: Forsooth, the man who depends too much on acts of worship of the gods soon meets with ruin. Making your enemy perform the great sacrifice called Vishvajit and divest him by that means of all his wealth.

sa: ततः पुरस्ताद्भगवान्निशाकरः समुत्थितस्तामभिहर्षयंश्चमूम्। दिवाकरापीतरसा महौषधी: पुनः स्वकेनैव गुणेन योजयन्॥
en: Cheering up that great army the divine Moon rose before it in the sky, once more giving moisture, by his own force, to the terrestrial herbs and plants whose juice has been drunk up by the Sun.

sa: तालवत् कुरुते मूलं बालः शत्रुरुपेक्षितः। गहनेऽग्निरिवोत्सृष्टः क्षिप्रं संजायते महान्॥
en: If an enemy is despised and over looked, he may soon grow like a palm tree extending its roots, or like a spark of fire in the deep forest that may soon flame upto a great conflagration.

sa: इघुसम्बाधमाकाशं कुर्वन् कपिवरध्वजः। यदाऽऽयात् कथमासीत् तु तदा पार्थं समीक्षताम्॥
en: When that son of Pritha bearing the device of the foremost of apes on his banner, came, overspreading the sky with his shower of shafts, what became the state of your mind at the sight of him?

sa: अपोवाह रणे भीरून् कश्मलेनाभिसंवृतान्। यथा वैतरणी प्रेतान् प्रेतराजपुरं प्रति॥
en: Just as the river Vaitarani conveys all departed spirits to the dominions of the ruler of spirits, so, in that afternoon, that river carried away (with its bloody currents) all cowards that became overwhelmed with a swoon.

sa: नप्राकृतं कंचन योधयामि। यस्यास्ति शक्तिर्व्यवसाययुक्तो ददातु मे शीघ्रमिहाद्य युद्धम्॥
en: Stationed in this car holding the bow and arrows in my hands, I will not fight any that is ignoble. Him that has strength, and that also understand this business, let him today speedily give me battle.

sa: प्रद्युम्नश्च महाबाहुस्त्वं च सात्वत विश्रुतः। अस्त्रे नारायणसम: संकर्षणसमो बले॥
en: One among them is the mighty armed Pradyumna and the other is yourself, O Satvata hero, who both are well-known in the world. Equal to Narayana himself in the use of weapons, so Samkarshana in physical strength.

sa: प्रबभौ ज्वलमानेव दिव्या दिव्येन वर्चसा। नवमेघप्रतीकाशा दिवमावृत्य विष्ठिता। आयता विपुला रम्या विपाप्मा विगतक्लमा॥ उत्तमद्रव्यसम्पन्ना रत्नप्रकारतोरणा। बहुचित्रा बहुधना सुकृता विश्वकर्मणा।॥
en: With its effulgence which was the mixture of both celestials and terrestrial light, it appeared as if it was on fire. Like a mass of new clouds rising in the sky, it filled the whole of the view. It was spacious large, charming, soothing, full of celestials effulgence, and filled with all sorts of excellent things, it was adorned with jeweled walls and gates, with many pictures and much wealth. It appeared like the work of Vishvakarma himself.

sa: निकृत्तबाहुर्विनिकृत्तपादो विदार्य वक्रं वडवामुखाभम्। दुद्राव रामं सहसाभिगर्जन् राहुर्यथा चन्द्रमिवान्तरिक्षे॥
en: Having his arms cut off and his legs also severed, (Kumbhakarma), opening wide his mouth resembling in sheen the mouth of a mare, roaring swiftly darted against Rāghava, even as Rāhu pursue the Moon in the firmament.

sa: नृशंसशील क्षुद्रात्मन् नित्यं ब्राह्मणकण्टक। त्वत्कृते शङ्कितैरग्नौ मुनिभिः पात्यते हविः॥
en: You of a cruel disposition, you of ignoble soul, you that are aye a thorn (in the side) of Brāhmanas, it is for you that ascetics, frightened and dispirited, have so long been pouring the clarified butter.

sa: इतीदमुक्तः स मुनिस्तदानीं प्रत्याह यत्तच्छृणु राजसिंह। मनन्यचित्तः सह सोदरीयैः॥
en: Described by me, O foremost of kings, listen, with rapt attention, O best of men, with all your brothers, to what the sage Ushanas then said after he had been thus addressed by that king of Danavas.

sa: पूजिताश्च ययुर्विप्रा राजानमभिनन्द्य तम्। राजा च हर्षमापेदे पाण्डवः ससुहृज्जनः॥
en: Duly adored the Brahmanas went away, having pleased the king with their blessing. The royal son of Pandu also, with all his friends, became highly happy. tree with all its blasted spouts by the thunder of Indra.

sa: इतीदमुक्तः स मुनिस्तदानीं प्रत्याह यत्तच्छृणु राजसिंह। मनन्यचित्तः सह सोदरीयैः॥
en: Described by me, O foremost of kings, listen, with rapt attention, O best of men, with all your brothers, to what the sage Ushanas then said after he had been thus addressed by that king of Danavas.

sa: एवंविधेषु दातव्या न समृद्धेषु भारत। को गुणो भरतश्रेष्ठ समृद्धेष्वभिवर्जितम्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, O descendant of Bharata, you should always give away to such men and not to those who are wealthy. What merit is there to give (wealth) to one who is wealthy?

sa: तेषां प्रतिष्ठिता कीर्तिर्यावत् स्थास्यति मेदिनी। गृहस्थैर्दानतपसा यैर्लोका वै विनिर्जिताः॥
en: Their fame will last as long as the world will last. I have related to you, O Yudhishthira, this story of those good householders, who have attained to eternal regions by virtue of their charities and penances.

sa: महार्थं लघुसंयुक्तं कर्तुमर्हसि मानद। तस्य मे सर्वकार्येषु कार्यमेतन्मतं महत्॥
en: O bestower of honour, it behoves you to accomplish first that task which is the most serious, with great activity. Of all these tasks therefore, I do think the task of aiding Arjuna should be accomplished first.

sa: अहिंस्रः सर्वभूतेषु सत्यवाक् सुदृढव्रतः। स चकार यथाकालमाहारं पतितैः फलैः॥
en: And he felt mercy for all creatures, and was truthful in speech, and firm in the observance of austere vows. At the appointed hour he took food which consisted of fruit which had dropped from the trees.

sa: ततो विदह्यमानं मामुवाच भगवान् रविः। मुहूर्तं सह्यतां दाहस्तत: शीतीभविष्यति॥
en: While I was burning with the energy of the goddess, the holy Sun told me.-Do you suffer this burning sensation for only a little time. That will soon come to an end and you will be cool.

sa: अवसन्मद्गृहे तात ब्राह्मणो हरिपिङ्गलः। चीरवासा बिल्वदण्डी दीर्घश्मश्रुः कृशो महान्॥
en: Formerly in my house, O son, lived the Brahmana Durvasas whose complexion was green and tawny. Clad in rags, he had a stick made of the Bilva tree. His bcard was long and he was greatly emaciated.

sa: यथार्चिषोऽग्नेः पवनस्य वेगो मरीचयोऽर्कस्य नदीषु चापः। स्तद्वच्छरीराणि शरीरिणां तु॥
en: As the flames of fire, the current of the wind, the rays of the sun, and the waters of rivers, go and come, again and again, so the bodies of embodied creatures are going and coming repeatedly.

sa: आक्रीडमिव रुद्रस्य पुराभ्यर्दयतः पशून्। गजानां क्षुरनिर्मुक्तैः करैः सभुजगेव भूः॥
en: Or it then appeared like the sporting ground of Rudra where he slew creatures in days gone by. Portions of the field covered over with trunks of elephants, severed by Kshurapras, appeared as if covered by snakes.

sa: यथाश्चहृदयं वेद दाशार्हः परवीरहा। तथा शल्यो विजानीते हयज्ञानं महारथः॥
en: Even as that one, of the Dasharha race, who is the slayer of the hostile neroes, is thoroughly versed in knowledge about horses, so Shalya, that most powerful car-warriors, is also acquainted with the science of horses.

sa: तेऽवहन् युयुधानं तु मनोमारुतरंहसः। यथेन्द्रं हरयो राजन् पुरा दैत्यवधोद्यतम्॥
en: Those (steeds), fleet as the mind or the wind, carried Yuyudhana (to the field of battle) as the horses of Indra, O king, had, in days of yore, born him who was preparing to slay the Asuras.

sa: तथा तु तेनाभिहतस्तरस्वी नप्ता शिनेरिन्द्रसमानवीर्यः। हयान् निहत्याशु ननाद नादम्॥
en: Thus afflicted by him, Sini's grandson, possessed of great agility and endowed with might equal to that of Indra himself, quickly slew with his own arrows the steeds of Sudarsana and sent up (then) a loud war-cry.

sa: तदिदं हतभूयिष्ठं बलं मम नराधिप। पूर्वमष्यल्पकैः पार्थैर्हतं किमुत साम्प्रतम्॥
en: O lord of men, this our army the large part of which has been slain have already been massacred by the sons of Pritha, who were at first very few in number. What would be done now?

sa: द्रवमाणे महाराज कौरवाणां बलार्णवे। व्यूह्य पार्थः स्वकं सैन्यमतिष्ठद् भ्रातृभिर्वृतः॥
en: And when, O great king, the army of the Kauravas, that was like the vast ocean, had fled away, the son of Pritha, having arranged his own troops properly waited in the field with all his brothers.

sa: रथिनोऽभ्यधिको वीर कर्तव्यो रथसारथिः। तस्मात्त्वं पुरुषव्याघ्र नियच्छ तुरगान् युधि॥
en: That hero, who is superior to the warrior on the car, should be made to act as the charioteer. You do, therefore, hold the reins of the horses in the field of battle, O foremost of persons.

sa: तावुभौ विरथौ वीरौ कुरुणां कीर्तिवर्धनौ। व्यपाक्रमेतां युद्धात्तु प्रेक्षमाणौ परस्परम्॥
en: Then those two brave warriors, who were divested of their cars and who also had contributed to the increase of the glory of the Kurus, really fled away from the battle, looking each other in the face.

sa: तेषां शब्दो महानासीद् वज्राणां भिद्यतामिव। युद्धं समभवद् घोरं भैम्यलायुधयोर्नृप॥
en: The clash, produced by those trees and mountain crest, became as loud as the sound of the roaring thunder. Indeed the battle, that then raged between Alayudha and Bhima's son was, O monarch, fierce in the extreme.

sa: ततोऽस्य समरे बाणं भोजः प्रहरतां वरः॥ जीवितान्तकरं घोरं व्यसृजत्त्वरयान्वितः।
en: Thereupon the prince of the Bhojas, that foremost of chastisers of foes, shot with great activity at his antagonist a dreadful arrow, that was capable of bringing about the destruction of life, in the field of battle.

sa: हताश्वो विरथश्चैव छिन्नकेतुश्च मारिष। धन्वी धनुर्वरं गृह्य रथाद् भूमावतिष्ठत॥
en: O sire, after taken up another excellent bow, that great bowman who was now steedless and carless and whose standard and charioteer into minute pieces by numerous arrows. At this, the people sent forth a loud roar.

sa: नदी प्रवर्तयामास भीरूणां भयवर्धिनीम्। तं दृष्ट्वा तस्य विक्रान्तमन्तकस्येव रूपिणः॥
en: Such a river capable of striking terror into the hearts of the cowards, was then caused to flow on the field of battle. Then beholding the prowess of Arjuna, whose appearance then resembled that of the Destroyer.

sa: विव्याध सूतं निशितैश्चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्। मात्यकिं च त्रिभिविद्ध्वा पुनरष्टाभिरेव च॥
en: Pierced the charioteer of that Satvata hero; and then with another four sharp shafts, he pierced the latter's four steeds. Next piercing Satyaki himself with three arrows, he pierced him with a set of another cight shafts.

sa: ततः शक्ति महाराज स्वर्णघण्टां दुरासदाम्। प्राहिणोत् तव पौत्राय घोरामग्निशिखामिव॥
en: Thereupon, O great king, he (Chitra) threw at your grandson the shaft, called Shakti, which was decked with golden bells and which, again, was most irresistible and dreadful and which also, was like the flame of fire.

sa: शरैस्तैरचितं द्रोणं नापश्याम महारथम्। भास्करं जलदै रुद्धं वर्षास्विव विशाम्पते॥
en: O ruler of men, covered as he then was with those arrows, we could not seen that mighty car-warrior Drona, even as men cannot seen the sun covered when it is with clouds during the rainy season.

sa: अन्यथा प्रतिपन्नास्तु विवृद्धा ये च कर्मणः। स्वकर्मनिरतानां च ब्राह्मणानां शुभैषिणाम्॥ संस्कारेणोर्ध्वमायान्ति यतमाना: सलोकताम्। स्वर्गे गच्छन्ति देवानामित्येषा वैदिकी श्रुतिः॥
en: Those men who take birth in orders other than human beings, by growing up in view of the religions ceremonies of Brahmanas devoted to the duties of their own caste and desirous of doing good to all creatures, succeed through the help of such purificatory rites, in ascending upwards. Indeed, struggling, they at last attain the sam? regions with thcsc pious Brahmanas. Indeed, they go to the celestial region. This is the Vedic Shruti.

sa: सकृज्जातिगुणोपेतः सङ्गत्या गृहमागतः। अतिथिः पूजितो ब्रह्मस्तेन मां नाजहात् स्मृतिः॥
en: Gifted with birth and accomplishments, that Brahmana, while travelling, came to my house once as a guest. I received him with respectful hospitality. One account of the merit of that deed my memory has not forsaken me.

sa: तिलान् श्राद्धे प्रशंसन्ति दानमेतद्ध्यनुत्तमम्। तान् प्रयच्छस्व विप्रेभ्यो विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा॥
en: The gift of sesame at Shraddhas is highly spoken of. The gift of sesame is a very superior gift. Do you make gifts of sesame to the Brahmanas according to the rites laid down in the scriptures.

sa: तल्यमुत्थाय यो नित्यं संध्ये द्वेस्तमयोदये। पठेच्छुचिरनावृत्तः स धर्मफलभाग् भवेत्॥
en: That man, who rising carly in the morning, takes the names of these kings at the two twilight's, viz., at sunset and sunrise, with a pure body and mind and without distracted attention, wins great religious merit.

sa: अब्भक्षा वायुभक्षाश्च सुधाभक्षश्च ये सदा। व्रतैश्च विविधैर्युक्तास्तान् नमस्यामि माधव॥
en: I bow to them, O Madhava, who live upon water only, or upon air alone, or upon the residue of the food that is offered to deities and guests, and who practise all sorts of excellent VOWS.

sa: ब्राह्मणास्तात भुञ्जनास्त्रेताग्निं प्रीणयन्त्युत। माध्यन्दिनं ते सवनं ददतस्तात वर्तताम्॥ ।
en: Let the sacrifice of gift proceed in your house at midday, O son, and do you also distribute kine and gold and dresses. By acting thus, you are sure to please the king of the celestials himself.

sa: उमोवाच गार्हस्थ्यो मोक्षधर्मश्च सज्जनाचरितस्त्वया। भाषितो जीवलोकस्य मार्गः श्रेयस्करो महान्॥
en: Uma said You have described the Religion of the householders, that of Liberation, and that which is based upon the observances of the pious. These paths are noble and highly beneficial to the world of living creatures.

sa: गान्धारी मातरं स्मृत्वा धृतराष्ट्रकृतेन च। तेन जीवसि राजंस्त्वं निहतास्त्वनुगास्तव॥
en: Recollecting my mother Gandhari, and for the sake of Dhritarashtra also, I have not taken your life. It is for this, o king, that you live still, Many of your followers, however, have been killed by me.

sa: बिभेति हि यथा शक्रो ब्रह्मचारिप्रधर्षितः॥ तद् ब्रह्मचर्यस्य फलमृषीणामिह दृश्यते।
en: If a Brahmacharin gives way to anger on account of any slight, the chief of the deities himself trambles in fear. This is the visible fruit of the vow of Brahamacharya that is observed by the Rishis.

sa: यदि विद्यामुपाश्रित्य नरः सुखमवाप्नुयात्॥ न विद्वान् विद्यया हीनं वृत्त्यर्थमुपसंश्रयेत्।
en: If by the acquisition of learning one could acquire the happiness of riches then no man of learning could be found living, for the very means of his livelihood, under the protection of one shorn of learning.

sa: सर्वमेतन्नरव्याघ्र भवत्येतावता कृतम्। योधाश्चापि न हन्तव्या धनञ्जय रणे त्वया॥
en: O foremost of men, you should consider your task as accomplished if only you disable those hostile kings! You should not also, O Dhananjaya, kill the warriors of those kings who may come forth to fight you.

sa: ततो यूपोच्छ्ये प्राप्ते घड् बैल्वान् भरतर्षभ। खादिरान् बिल्वसमितांस्तावतः सर्ववर्णिनः॥
en: When the time came for erccting the sacrificial stake, O chief of Bharata's race, six stakes were set up which were made of Bilva, six which were made of Khadira, and six which were made of Sarvavarnin.

sa: घोषवन्ति च यानानि युक्तान्यथ सहस्रशः॥ भक्ष्यभोज्यमयाः शैला वासांस्याभरणानि च।
en: Thousands of vehicles with horses and other animals harnessed thereto and with wheels whose caltter is always loud, are all there. Mountains of food and all enjoyable articles and heaps of cloths and ornaments are also there.

sa: गिरिप्रपाते गहने चैत्यस्थाने चतुष्पथे। दीपदानं भवेन्नित्यं य इच्छेद् भूतिमात्मनः॥
en: The who desires his aggrandisement and prosperity should always give lights at descents from mountains, in roads through forests and inaccessible regions, under sacred tress standing in the midst of human dwellings, and in crossings of streets.

sa: स्कन्नमात्रं च तच्छुक्रं स्रवेण परिवृज्ञ सः। आज्यवन्मन्त्रतश्चापि सोऽजूहांद् भृगुनन्दन॥
en: As soon as the seed came out, he took it up with the sacrificial ladle and poured it as a libation of clarified butter, O delighter of the Bhrigus with the necessary Mantras, on the burning fire.

sa: यातुधान्युवाच नामनैरुक्तमेतत् ते दुःखव्याभाषिताक्षरम्। नैतद् धारयितुं शक्यं गच्छावतर पद्मिनीम्॥
en: Yatudhani said The etymological signification you have given me of your name is what I cannot fully understand, on account of the many inflections the root has undergone. Go and plunge into this take filled with lotuses,

sa: फलकामो यशस्कामः पुष्टिकामश्च नित्यदा। घृतं दद्याद् द्विजातिभ्यः पुरुषः शुचिरात्मवान्॥
en: That man who wishes for the reward of happiness in the next world, who wishes for the fame and prosperity, should with a purified heart and having purified himself, make gifts of clarified butter to the Brahmanas.

sa: आश्रमाणां च सर्वेषां गार्हस्थ्यं नात्र संशयः। लोकानामादिरव्यक्तं सर्वस्यान्तस्तदेव च॥
en: Of all the modes of life, that of the householder is the first. Of this there is not doubt. The Unmanifest is the source of all the worlds as well as is the end of every thing.

sa: मन्ये पृथा वेपमाना कृशा धमनिसंतता॥ हा तात! धर्मराजेति समाक्रन्दन्महाभये।
en: I suppose that Pritha, emaciated and reduced to a from in which all her nerves became visible, must have trembled in fear and cried aloud, saying, O son Yudhishthira! and awaited the terrible approach of the fire.

sa: देवास्तेजस्विनो ह्यस्मात् प्रभावन्तः प्रकाशकाः। तामसा राक्षसाश्चैव तस्माद् दीपः प्रदीयते॥
en: It is by giving lights that the celestials have become gifted with beauty, energy, and resplendence. By abstention from such a deed, the Rakshasas have become gifted with the opposite attributes. Hence, one should always give lights.

sa: ब्रह्मतेजोमयाः सर्वे कीर्तिता लोकभावनाः॥ लभन्ते हि शुभं सर्वे रुद्रानलवसुप्रभाः।
en: All these are gifted with the energy of Brahman and have been spoken of as creators of the universe. They have originated from Rudra and Anala and the Vasusa By reciting their namnes people get great benefits.

sa: संवृताभ्यां तु नेत्राभ्यां तमोभूतमचेतनम्। निर्दोमं निर्वषट्कारं जगद् वै सहसाऽभवत्॥
en: As soon as Mahadeva's eyes were thus covered, all the regions became dark, and life seemed to be extinct everywhere in the universe. The Homa rites ceased. The universe became suddenly deprived of the sacred Vashat Also.

sa: अग्नियोगवहो ग्रीष्मे विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा। चीवा॑ द्वादशवर्षाणि राजा भवति पार्थिवः॥
en: Having practised practised for twelve years, according to the rites laid down in the ordinances, the vow relating to the endurance of the five fires in the summer season, one becomes in his next life a king.

sa: यज बीजैः सहस्राक्ष त्रिवर्षपरमोषितैः॥ एष धर्मो महान् शक्र महागुणफलोदयः।
en: you of a hundred eyes do you perform the sacrifice with seeds of grain which have been kept for three years. This, O Shakra, would be fraught with great virtue and productive of fruits of high efficacy.

sa: प्रजावतो भरेथाश्च ब्राह्मणान् बहुकारिणः। प्रजावांस्तेन भवति यथा जनयिता तथा॥
en: You should support such Brahmanas as have children and as are capable of sending people to heaven. By acting thus, you are sure to get a large progeny-in fact, as large a progeny as the Prajapati himself.

sa: युवां ह्यदकधारास्ता भूतानि च समन्ततः। उत्तमास्त्रविदौ सम्यक् सर्वतो वारयिष्यथः॥
en: Expert as you are in excellent weapons, I pray you to prevent the showers of rain from coming down upon me and to prevent also any creatures from escaping when I begin to consume it (the forest).

sa: तथैवासीद् विदर्भेषु भीमो भीमपराक्रमः। शूरः सर्वगुणैर्युक्तः प्रजाकामः स चाप्रजः॥
en: Like him (Nala) there was a king among the Vidarbhas, named Bhima, who was warlike, possessor of immense power and all accomplishments and beloved of his subjects. But with all these virtues he was without an issue.

sa: इत्युक्तः स कुरुश्रेष्ठ गुरुणा गुरुवत्सलः। प्राञ्जलिः परिपप्रच्छ यत्तच्छृणु महामते॥
en: Thus addressed, O foremost one of Kuru's race, by his preceptor, that disciple who was greatly devoted to his preceptor, spoke as follows, with joined hands. Do you hear what he said, O you of great intelligence.

sa: भीषयित्वा स्थानीकं हत्वा योधान् वरान् वरान्। व्यतीत्य रथिनश्चापि द्रोणानीकमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: The mighty Bhima then having caused that great slapping sound and there by striking terror into the host of the enemy and slaying many best warriors and passing through that division, hied towards of division of Drona.

sa: स हि नानाविधैर्बाणैरिष्वस्त्रप्रवरो युधि॥ न्यहनद् द्विषता पूगान् गतासूनन्तको यथा।
en: That foremost of heroes, who was skilled in the management of arrows and weapons in battle, slaughtered large throngs of enemies with different kinds of shafts, even as Yama (Death) destroys the creatures, deprived of their lives.

sa: उपलभ्याप्सु चेद्गन्धं केचिद् ब्रूयुरनैपुणात्। पृथिव्यामेव तं विद्यादपां वायोश्च संश्रितम्॥
en: If anybody, perceiving Scent in Water, were from ignorance to say that it belongs to Water, he would make a mistake, for Scent is the attribute of Earth though it may exist in Water and also Wind.

sa: कचग्रहमनुप्राप्ता सास्मि कृष्ण वरा सती। पञ्चानां पाण्डुपुत्राणां प्रेक्षतां मधुसूदन॥
en: O Krishna, O slayer of Madhu, being the foremost of women and devoted to my husbands, even I was seized by the hair in the very sight of the Pandavas, each of whom was like an Indra.

sa: अविश्वस्ते विश्वसिषि मन्यसे वाध्रुवे ध्रुवम्। नित्यं कालपरीतात्मा भवत्येवं सुरेश्वर॥
en: You trust in that which is not worthy of trust. You consider that to be eternal which is not eternal. O king of the gods, one who is possessed and stupefied by Time really considers himself thus.

sa: नागभार्योवाच आर्जवेन विजानामि नासौ देवोऽनिलाशन। एकं तस्मिन् विजानामि भक्तिमानतिरोषण॥
en: Judging by his simplicity and candour I know that that Brahmana is not any god who lives on air. O you of great anger, I also know this, viz., that he respects you with all his heart.

sa: कदाचित् प्रातरुत्थाय पिस्पृक्षुः सलिलं शुचि। ध्रुवद्वारभवां गङ्गां जगामावततार च॥
en: One day, rising up early in the morning, he wished to perform his ablutions and for that purpose went to the river Ganga as the issued out of the pass called Dhruva, and plunged into the stream.

sa: विधिना स्वेन युक्ताभ्यां यथापूर्वं द्विजोत्तम। आस्थिताभ्यां सर्वकृच्छ्रे व्रतं सम्यगनुत्तमम्॥
en: In accordance, one after another, which such ordinances as are extraordinary and as apply to us two only, O best of twice-born ones, we are duly observing all excellent and high vows fraught with the austerest penances.

sa: परमध्यात्मकुशलमध्यात्मगतिनिश्चयम्। मैत्रावरुणिमासीनमभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः॥ स्वक्षरं प्रश्रितं वाक्यं मधुरं चाप्यनुल्बणम्। पप्रच्छर्षिवरं राजा करालजनकः पुरा॥ भगवश्रोतुमिच्छामि परं ब्रह्म सनातनम्। यस्मान्न पुनरावृत्तिमाप्नुवन्ति मनीषिणः॥
en: A perfect adept in that department of knowledge which is about the Soul and gifted with sure conclusions about all branches of that science, as Mairtravaruni, that foremost of Rishis, was seated, the king, approaching him with joined hands, asked him in humble words, well said and sweet and shorn of all controversial spirit, this question,-O holy one, I wish to hear of Supreme and Eternal Brahma by attaining to which men of wisdom have not to return.

sa: केचिदध्ययने युक्ता वेदव्रतपराः शुभाः। बुद्धिमन्तो गताः स्वर्गं तुष्टात्मानो जितेन्द्रियाः॥
en: Some have given themselves up to the study of the Vedas. Endued with auspiciousness and wedded to such study, these men, gifted with intelligence, and tranquil souls, and having their senses under complete control, attain to heaven.

sa: त्रेतादौ केवला वेदा यज्ञा वर्णाश्रमास्तथा। संरोधादायुषस्त्वेते व्यस्यन्ते द्वापरे युगे॥
en: In the beginning of Treta, the Vedas and sacrifices and the distribution of caste and the several modes of life existed in full. On account of the duration of life being decreased in Dvapara, those suffer decline.

sa: ततः स्वरोचिवः पुत्रं स्वयं शङ्खपदं नृप। अध्यापगत् पुराव्यग्रः सर्वलोकपतिर्विभुः॥
en: Svarochish-Manu, that Lord of all the worlds, that foremost of all persons gifted with power, then cheerfully gave the knowledge of that religion to his own son, O king, who was known by the name of Shankhapada.

sa: एतेषामुदयं स्थानं क्षयं च पृथिवीपते। हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि क्रोधस्योत्पत्तिमादितः॥
en: I shall now describe to you their origin, the objects upon which they rest, and the means of their destruction, O king. Listen, first, О king, with rapt attention, to the origin of anger truly and fully.

sa: प्रदक्षिणं तथा चक्रे प्रयतः शिरसा नतः। धरणीमवतीर्याथ पूतात्मासौ तदाभवत्॥
en: He went round the spot with a composed mind, bending his head in respect the while. Descending then on the Earth, he regarded himself purified for having seen that holy spot which is the residence of Mahadeva.

sa: तस्माद् वाक्कायमनसा नाचरेदशुभं नरः। शुभाशुभान्याचरन् हि तस्य तस्याश्नुते फलम्॥
en: Hence, one should never do any evil deed in speech, body, or mind. By doing good and evil deeds, one is sure to enjoy or reap the just consequences thereof. Nothing can be more certain than this.

sa: काषायधारणं मौण्ड्यं त्रिविष्टब्यं कमण्डलुम्। लिङ्गान्युत्पथभूतानि न मोक्षायेति मे मतिः॥
en: The putting on of brown cloths shaving of the head, bearing of the triple stick, and the water-pitcher, these are the external signs of one's mode of life. These are useless in helping one to acquire Liberation.

sa: कालेनाक्रम्य लोकेऽस्मिन् पच्यमाने बलीयसा॥ अज्येष्ठमकनिष्ठं च क्षिप्यमाणो न बुद्ध्यते।
en: Attacking the universe, powerful Time cooks it within itself and sweeps away every thing without caring for age or otherwise. Therefore, one who is being dragged by Time is unconscious of the noose put round one's neck.

sa: ये केचिद् विस्तरेणोक्ता नियमा ब्रह्मचारिणः॥ तान् सर्वानाचरेन्नित्यं भवेच्चानपगो गुरोः।
en: Whatever observances have been laid down in full for Brahmacharins should all be regularly practised by him. He should all be regularly practised by him. He should be always at the beck and call of his preceptor.

sa: तमेव शास्त्रकर्तारः प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः। निष्ठां नारायणमृर्षि नान्योऽस्तीति वचो मम॥
en: Those wise persons who are the authors of the scriptures say that Narayana, who is a Rishi, is the one object of respectful adoration in the universe, I say that there is no other being like Him.

sa: तुल्यं मम सहस्रं तु सुतानां ब्रह्मवादिनाम्। आयुश्चैव सपुत्रस्य संवत्सरशतायुतम्॥
en: He also conferred upon me a thousand solis, all possessed of equal merit and fully conversant with the Vedas. Through his favour their periods of life as also mine have become extended to ten millions of years.

sa: अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीमं बोध्यस्य पदसंचयम्। निर्वेदं प्रति विन्यस्तं तं निबोध युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Once on a time the royal son of Nahusa (Yayati) asked the Rishi Vodhya who had, on account of Rcnunciation, attained to tranquillity of soul and who had a through knowledge of the scriptures. The king said

sa: इन्द्रियाणां तु सर्वेषां वश्यात्मा चलितस्मृतिः। आत्मनः सम्प्रदानेन मर्यो मृत्युमुपाश्नुते॥
en: That person, however, who becomes the slave of all his senses and whose ideas of right and wrong have been confounded, already subject as he is to death, actually meets with death by such surrender of self.

sa: अनुलोमेन जायन्ते लीयन्ते प्रतिलोमतः। गुणा गुणेषु सततं सागरस्योर्मयो यथा।॥
en: Al every new Creation, the qualities start into being in the lateral order, and (when Destruction comes) they merge in a reverse order, like the waves of the ocean disappearing in the ocean from which they originate.

sa: चिन्तयामास देवेन्द्रो मन्युनाऽथ परिप्लुतः। उपकारोऽस्य राजर्षेः कृतो नापकृतं मया।॥
en: Saying this, the king of the gods, viz., Indra of a hundred sacrifices, assuming the form of a Brahmana, went to the capital of the king and meeting all the children succeeded in creating dissensions amongst them.

sa: मनस्याकृतयो मग्ना मनस्त्वभिगतं मतिम्। मतिस्त्वभिगता ज्ञानं ज्ञानं चाभिगतं परम्॥
en: All objects that the mind apprehends through the senses can be withdrawn into the mind; the mind can be withdrawn into the understanding; the Understanding can be withdrawn into the Soul, and the Soul into the Supreme.

sa: यज्वा दानपतिः क्षान्तो वृत्ते च परमे स्थितः। सत्यवागनसूयुश्च शीलवानियतेन्द्रियः।१०॥
en: He celebrates sacrifices, makes gifts, abstains from doing injury, and practises forgiveness. His conduct is in every way good. Truthful in speech and shorn of malice, his conduct is good and his senses are under proper control.

sa: च्छची प्रधृष्याप्रतिरूपरूपाम्। न मादृशीं राक्षस धर्षयित्वा पीतामृतस्यापि तवास्ति मोक्षः॥
en: O Räkşasa, it might be possible for one to live on this earth treating contemptuously the wife of the holder of thunder-bolt, but insulting me none shall escape the hands of Death even if he drinketh nectar.

sa: प्रययौ तूर्णमास्थाय राघवो ज्वलितः श्रिया। स पर्जन्य इवाकाशे स्वनवानभिनादयन्॥
en: Ascending the car, Raghava, of great effulgence, went speedily on, making (the space) resounded like to the muttering cloud on the sky. He issued out of his abode like the beautiful moon passing through a huge cloud.

sa: उवाचापि प्रहृष्टेव सा दु:खवशवर्तिनी। वाङ्मात्रेण न भावेन वाचा संसज्जमानया॥
en: That excellent one of high renown, embracing Rāma and smelling his head, with her voice choked, as if all pleased, though placed under the influence of dire distress in reality, uttered mantras and spoke to him thus.

sa: मया रामेण च त्यक्तं शाश्वतं सत्कृतं गुणैः। इक्ष्वाकुकुलमक्षोभ्यमाकुलं पालयिष्यसि॥
en: Renounced by me as well as Rāma, this Iksvaku line existing from a time immemorial, and ennobled by excellent qualities, and incapable of coming by grief, you will rule, when it shall have been overwhelmed with misfortune.

sa: आश्रममृषिविरहितं प्रभुः क्षणमपि न जहौ स राघवः। स्तापसाश्चार्षचरिते धृतगुणाः॥
en: (Thenceforth) Rāghava never for a moment left that asylum forsaken by the sages., Rāghava having such qualities in his character as were likely to stand the sages in stead, the ascetics (that remained behind) ever followed Rāghava.

sa: सोऽहं पितुर्निदेशं तु किमर्थं नानुपालये। सत्यप्रतिश्रवः सत्यं सत्येन समयीकृतम्॥
en: Why should I not then obey the mandate of my father? My father was of truthful promise and of righteous ways and with the object of observing his promise, he laid on me this (for faithful performance).

sa: सोऽश्वान् सुमन्त्रः संयम्य सूर्येऽस्तं समुपागत। प्रभूतयवसान् कृत्वा बभूव प्रत्यनन्तरः॥
en: Having said this to Sumitrā's son, Raghava spoke to Sumantra, saying, “O mild one, do you now heedfully tend the horses.” Then at sunset, fastening the horses, Sumantra fed them plentifully with grass, and then came back.

sa: चरितब्रह्मचर्यस्य विद्यास्नातस्य धीमतः। धर्मे प्रयतमानस्य को राज्यं मद्विधो हरेत्॥
en: Who like myself ever deprives one that has led a Brahmacharya mode of life, that is endowed with understanding and performed his bath after having acquired learning, and that is always intent on righteousness, of one's kingdom?

sa: तावारोप्य ततः स्कन्धं राघवौ रजनीचरः। विराधो विनदन् घोरं जगामाभिमुखो वनम्॥
en: And having deposited the Rāghavas on his shoulders, Virādha-ranger* of night-sending up dreadful shouts, directed his course towards the forest. Another reading is:-That ranger of the night laid on his shoulders, those ones, who were puffed up with their exceeding prowess.

sa: ब्रह्मर्षे स्वागतं तेऽस्तु तपसा स्म सुतोषिताः॥ ब्राह्मण्यं तपसोग्रेण प्राप्तवानसि कौशिक।
en: Then the celestials with Pitamaha at their head, addressed the high-souled Viśvāmitra in sweet-words, saying, "Welcome, O Brahmarşi! Well pleased have we been with your penances. And, O son of Kusika, in consideration of your fiery asceticism, you have obtained Brāhmaṇahood.'

sa: इहस्थोऽहं प्रपश्यामि रावणं जानकी तथा। अस्माकमपि सौपर्णं दिव्यं चक्षुर्बलं तथा॥
en: Resting here, I see Ravana and Janaki. We have excellent Sauparana' clairvoyance. *Clairvoyance attained by success in knowledge respecting the spiritual Golden eyes. Thus far the commentator. We leave the abstruse point to the apostles of theosophy and spiritism for illucidation.

sa: निन्दाम्यहं कर्म कृतं पितुस्तद् यस्त्वामगृह्णाद् विषमस्थबुद्धिम्। बुद्ध्यानयैवंविधया चरन्तं सुनास्तिकं धर्मपथादपेतम्॥
en: I blame this act of my father's, viz., that he took (for his (for his priest) one of perverse understanding, who range by help of such an intellect, who is frightfully atheistic, and who has swerved from the path of righteousness.

sa: स तु वर्षसहस्राणि तपस्तप्त्वा महद्वने॥ पितामहाद् वरं लेभे सर्वमौशनसं धनम्।
en: Having for a thousand years thousand years practised austerities in this vast forest, he obtained a boon from the Great-father,-in virtue of which he had attained consummate mastery in his art, as well as absolute control over the materials required therein.

sa: यानैश्च मुख्यैः परिचारकैश्च सुसंवृता गच्छतु राजपुत्री। र्नेयं वृता ते वरसम्प्रदाने॥
en: And let the daughter of the king go to the forest, surrounded by excellent cars and servants, and taking with her attires and other necessary things. When you demanded the (fulfilment of the) promise, you had not your eye on Sita.

sa: यत्र त्रयं त्रयो लोकाः पवित्रं तत्समं भुवि। नान्यदस्ति शुभापाङ्गे तेनेदमभिराध्यते॥
en: In the worship of the parents are fulfilled the triple object of religious pursuit, and the adoration of the three regions, there is nothing equal to it, conducing to purity; so do I, O you of excellent-look , resort to it.

sa: तं राममेवानुविचिन्तयन्तं समीक्ष्य देवी शयने नरेन्द्रम्। उपोपविश्याधिकमार्तरूपा विनिःश्वसन्तं विललाप कृच्छ्रम्॥
en: Then seeing that foremost of men absorbed in the contemplation of Rāma, that noble dame sat by him, and afflicted with greater grief, began to indulge in sorrow,* sighing heavily. *Another text reads vinisvasantam, joining it to narendram, foremost of men.

sa: त्रयी चान्वीक्षिकी चैव वार्ता च भरतर्षभ। दण्डनीतिश्च विपुला विद्यास्तत्र निदर्शिताः॥
en: The religious rites laid down in the three Vedas, knowledge, and the acts necessary for the support of life, (viz., agriculture, trade, etc.), O foremost of Bharata's race, and the very extensive branch of learning called legislation, were described in it.

sa: एष मूर्धाभिषिक्तानामग्रे गत्वा परंतपः। सतृणं ग्रसते पांसुं पश्य कालस्य पर्ययम्॥
en: Alas, this destroyer of foes used to trample at the head of all Kshatriyas that had their locks sprinkled with holy water at the time of coronation. Alas, he now eats the dust. Witness the reverses of fortune that time brings.

sa: किं पुनः सहिता वीराः कृतवैराश्च पाण्डवैः। अथवा सर्व एवैते पाण्डवस्यानुयायिभिः॥
en: What need I say then of all these heroes, every one of whom has wrongs to avenge on the Pandavas, when united together? All these, O monarch, will fight with the followers of the Pandavas and will kill them in battle.

sa: यद्धि गुप्तावशिष्टं स्यात् तद्वित्तं धर्मकामयोः। संचयान्न विसर्गी स्याद् राजा शास्त्रविदात्मवान्॥
en: Having kept apart a sufficient portion, he should with the remaining portion, acquire religious merit and gratify his desires for pleasure. That king, who is acquainted with duties and who is gifted with intelligence, would never squander what has been stored.

sa: जावान् स्यात् स्वयूथ्येषु भौमानि चरणैः क्षिपेत्। जातपक्षः परिस्पन्देत् प्रेक्षेद् वैकल्यमात्मनः॥
en: He should treat equitably his own subjects; cause the crops of his enemies to be crushed by the foot of his cavalry, march against enemies when his own wings have become strong; and mark all the sources of his own weakness.

sa: यथा नगाग्रं बहुधातुचित्रं यथा नभश्च ग्रहचन्द्रचित्रम्। ददर्श युक्तीकृतचारुमेघचित्रं विमानं बहुरत्नचित्रम्॥
en: And (Hanumān) saw the car variegated with countless gems; like unto the top of a mountain variegated with innumerable metals; or like the firmament with the moon and the planets, or like clouds of diverse hues fused into a homogeneous whole.

sa: चेरतुश्च चिरं चित्रं मण्डलं सव्यदक्षिणम्। बाणवेगात्समुत्क्षिप्तावन्योन्यमपराजितौ॥ तयोर्भूतानि वित्रेसुर्युगपत्संप्रयुध्यतोः। रौद्रयोः सायकमुचोर्यमान्तकनिकाशयोः॥
en: And forming a circle, they passed each other by the right side. Uprooting the earth with the vehemence of their arrows, irrepressible by each other, fighting equally discharging arrows, they arrows looked dreadful like Death himself-and created terror in all creatures.

sa: तत्त्वया चरता ले कान्धर्मोऽपि निहतो महान्। अधर्मः प्रगृहीतश्च तेनास्मदलिनः परे॥
en: You, ranging the three worlds, worlds, had extinguished pregnant piety, and reaped unrighteousness; and it is for this that your foes have waxed potent. *While ranging the three worlds on a career of conquest, you didst, disturbing sacrifices, etc., wrong righteousness.

sa: यथैव स्थावरं व्यक्तं जङ्गमं च तथाविधम्। नायमर्थस्तथा युक्तस्त्वद्विधो न विपद्यते॥
en: Inasmuch as the immobile (albeit devoid of any regard for virtue) are nevertheless happy and as the mobile also are so, this virtue cannot lead to happiness. (If it were so), one like you would have not been placed in peril.

sa: त्वमुत्तमा सगिरिवना वसुन्धरा सभास्करं वितिमिरमम्बरं तथा। महोदधिः सतिमितिमिगिलस्तथा महोर्मिमान्बहुमकरो झषाकुलः॥
en: You are the beautiful earth with its mountains and forests, you are the clear sky with the sun that drives away all darkness. You are the great ocean with heaving billows and abounding in Timingilas, Timis, Makaras and various other fishes.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच विशेषार्थी ततो भीष्मः पौत्राणां विनयेप्सया॥ इष्वस्त्रज्ञान् पर्यपृच्छदाचार्यान् वीर्यसम्मतान्। नाल्पधी महाभागस्तथानानास्त्रकोविदः॥ नादेवसत्त्वो विनयेत् कुरूनस्त्रे महाबलान्। इति संचिन्त्य गाङ्गेयस्तदा भरतसत्तमः॥ द्रोणाय वेदविदुषे भारद्वाजाय धीमते। पाण्डवान् कौरवांश्चैव ददौ शिष्यान् नरर्षभ।॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Being desirous of giving his grand sons a superior education, Bhishma was in search of a preceptor, who was endued with energy and who was well-skilled in the science of arms. O best of the Bharata race, deciding that none who was not possessed of great intelligence, who was not illustrious, who was not a perfect master of the science of arms, who was not as powerful as the celestial, shall be the preceptor of the Kurus, the son of Ganga (Bhishma), placed the Pandavas and the Kurus under the tuition of the son of Bharadvaja, the wise Drona, learned in all the Vedas. Having been honoured according to the proper form by the illustrious Bhishma.

sa: काषायं सुलभं पश्चान्मुनीनां शममिच्छताम्। साम्राज्यं तु भवेच्छक्यं वयं योत्स्यामहे परान्॥
en: Those that have become Rishis with the desire of obtaining peace of mind get the red clothes with ease. Therefore, if we defeat the enemy, the imperial dignity will be easily obtained by us. We should, therefore, fight with the enemy.

sa: श्रुत्वा धर्मिष्ठमाख्यानमास्तीकं पुण्यवर्धनम्। यन्मां त्वं पृष्टवान्ब्रह्मछ्रुत्वा डुण्डुभभाषितम्। व्येतु ते सुमहद्ब्रह्मन्कौतूहलमरिंदम॥
en: O Brahman, O chastiser of foes, (now you have) heard this sacred history of Astika, a history which increases virtue and which you asked me to narrate after hearing the story of the Dundubha, let now your great curiosity be satisfied.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नाटते रौद्रात् पाल्यमानात् किरीटिना। तैर्वृतः सर्वतः शूरः पाञ्चाल्यापसदस्ततः॥ केकयैश्चेदिकारूषैर्मत्स्यैरन्यैश्च भूमिपैः। व्याकुलीकृतमाचार्यं पिपीलैरुरगं यथा॥ कर्मण्यसुकरे सक्तं जघानेति मतिर्मम। योऽधीत्य चतुरो वेदान् साङ्गानाख्यानपञ्चमान्॥
en: Save the fierce warrior Dhrishtadyumna supported by Arjuna himself. I think that when these heroes namely the Kekayas, the Chedis, the Karushas, the Matsyas and the other rulers of earth, encompassing the preceptor hemmed him in on all sides, like ants pressing upon a serpent and that when he was occupied in the achievement of some difficult feat, then the vilest among the Panchalas must have slain him. He who, having studied the four Vedas along with their auxiliaries and the Histories constituting the fifth Veda.

sa: नारद उवाच एवमुक्ताभवत् प्रीता प्राञ्जलिर्भगवन्मुखी। संहारे नाकरोद् बुद्धिं प्रजानां हितकाम्यया॥
en: Narada said Thus spoken to, the lady became pleased and she stood with her face turned towards the illustrious god. And out of desire for doing good to the creatures, she did not set her heart upon the destruction of creature.

sa: रथी च रथिना योध्यो गजेन गजधूर्गतः। अश्वेनाश्री पदातिश्च पादातेनैव भारत॥
en: A car-warrior should fight only with a car warrior. He who rode on an elephant should fight only with another such combatant. O descendant of Bharata, a horse man must fight with a horse man and a foot-soldier with a footsoldier.

sa: कुरूणामहितो नित्यं न च राजाऽवबुध्यते। को हि नाम समानेषु राजसूदारकर्मसु॥
en: You are ever devoted to what is to the injury of the Kurus, But the king knows it not. Who else is there who would seek to sap the energy of these kings that are equal and create discord among them,

sa: त्रैलोक्यस्य हितार्थाय रक्षसामहिताय च। लङ्कां प्रवेशिता सीता रावणेन दुरात्मना ॥
en: On Sītā having entered Lankā, the great father addressed the gratified Devendra of an hundred sacrifices, For bringing about the weal of the three worlds, and the woe of the Rākşasas, Sītā has been taken into Lankā by the wickedminded, Rāvaņa.

sa: ततः प्राग्ज्योतिषो राजा नागराज समास्थितः। यथा वज्रधरः पूर्वं संग्रामे तारकामये॥
en: Thereupon the ruler of the Pragjyotishas mounted on his princes of elephants like the wielder of the thunder bolt mounting on his Airavat in the days of yore at the time of the battle caused by the insult offered by Taraka.

sa: कर्मभिः शुचिभिर्देवि शुद्धात्मा विजितेन्द्रियः। शूद्रोऽपि द्विजवत् सेव्य इति ब्रह्माब्रवीत् स्वयम्॥४८
en: Even a Shudra, O goddess, who has purified his soul by pure deeds and who has controlled all his senses, deserves to be waited upon and served with respect as a Brahmana. This has been said by the SelfCreate Brahman himself.

sa: अलब्धलाभाय च लब्धवृद्धये यथार्हतीर्थप्रतिपादनाय यशस्विनं वेदविदं विपश्चितं बहुश्रुतं ब्राह्मणमेव वासय॥
en: Therefore for obtaining what you have not got and multiplying what you have got and for spending that on proper objects and persons, do keep with you a Brahmana of fame, wise, experienced and well-versed in the knowledge of the Vedas.

sa: सा रामसंकीर्तनवीतशोका रामस्य शोकेन समानशोका। शरन्मुखेनाम्बुदशेषचन्द्रा निशेव वैदेहसुता बभूव ॥
en: On hearing about Rāma, Sītā was greatly delighted and she was equally grieved on hearing of his sorrow. And it appeared like the rising of the moon and the appearance of the clouds at the same time in an autumnal night.

sa: पितासि लोकस्य चराचरस्य त्वमस्य पूज्यश्च गुरुर्गरीयान्। न त्वत्समोऽस्त्यभ्यधिकः कुतोऽन्यो लोकत्रयेऽप्यप्रतिमप्रभाव॥
en: You are the Father of the universe, of movable and immovable; you are the great Master deserving of all worship. There is none equal to you. How can there be one greater than you whose power is matchless in these worlds.

sa: कौमुदे मासि रेवत्यां शरदन्ते हिमागमे। स्फीतसस्यसुखे काले कल्पः सत्त्ववतां वरः॥
en: In the month of Kaumuda (Kartika) under the constellation of Revati after the passing away of Autumn and in the dewy season and at time when the earth had an abundance of crops on it, that foremost of men of prowess

sa: महाभये वीतभयः कृतास्रः समागमे शत्रुबलामर्दी। सकृद् रथेनाप्रतिमान रथौघान् पदातिसंघान् गदयाऽभिनिघ्नन्॥
en: When that one who is without fear even in great dangers and skilled in the use of weapons and the slayer of the enemies armies, riding on his beautiful car works havoc with his mace among the numerous cars and foot-soldiers;

sa: स्त्रीसमक्षमहं दीनो बद्धः शत्रुवशं गतः॥ युधिष्ठिरस्योपहृतः किं नु दुःखमतः परम्।
en: Alas, what greater sorrow could be mine than that I should thus be offered as tribute to Yudhishthira in the very sight of our women, myself in chains and in great misery and also under the complete control of our enemies!

sa: ययातिरुवाच ययातिरस्मि राजर्षिः क्षीणपुण्यश्च्युतो दिवः। पतेयं सत्स्विति ध्यायन् भवत्सु पतितस्ततः॥
en: Yayati said I am the royal Rishi Yayati and the religious merit acquired by me being spent up have been turned out from heaven; and wishing in my mind that I should fall among the good, I have fallen among you.

sa: तच्चेद् दद्यादसंगेन सत्कृत्यानवमन्य च। प्रियं मे स्यान्महाबाहो मुच्येरन् महतो भयात्॥
en: And if they give us that for the sake of honesty without insult to us and with due respect to yourself, then, O you with long arms, they should do what is desired by me and themselves escape a great evil.

sa: ततस्तीरे समुद्रस्य यत्र शिश्ये स पार्थिवः॥ तत्रैवोवास धर्मात्मा सहितः सर्ववानरैः।
en: Then that virtuous lord of the earth together with all the monkeys took up his (temporary) quarter son that portion of the sea-shore where had lain down before (on a bed of Kusha grass to invoke the aid of the ocean).

sa: अर्हते याचमानाय प्रदेयं तच्छुभं भवेत्। अप्रमादी भवेदेतैः स चाप्यष्टगुणो भवेत्॥
en: (Sixth sort) that a gift should be made to one asking for it; by this happiness can always be attained. By these means can one gain a true knowledge of self and the last one is made up of eight qualities.

sa: ते रथान् रथिनः श्रेष्ठा हयांश्च हयकोविदाः। सज्जयन्ति स्म नागांश्च नागशिक्षास्वनुष्ठिताः॥
en: The foremost among the car-warriors looked to the equipment of the cars, while those who were experts about horses looked to the harnessing of the steeds, and those who knew all about elephants began to get ready the elephants for war.

sa: अविद्यः पुरुषः शोच्यः शोच्यं मैथुनमप्रजम्। निराहाराः प्रजाः शोच्याः शोच्यं राष्ट्रमराजकम्॥
en: One who is ignorant ought to be pitied; and intercourse that does not produce offspring ought to be pitied. The subjects of a king who go without food are to be pitied; and anarchy in a kingdom ought to be regretted.

sa: श्रीमन्तं ज्ञातिमासाद्य यो ज्ञातिरवसीदति। दिग्धहस्तं मृग इव स एनस्तस्य विन्दति॥
en: If having come face to face with a cousin who is prosperous, one shrinks like a deer in the presence of a man armed with arrows; then cousin gets transferred on his own shoulders the sins of his less prosperous cousin.

sa: नाममात्रेण तुष्येत छत्रेण च महीपतिः। भृत्येभ्यो विसृजेदर्थान् नैकः सर्वहरो भवेत्॥
en: The lord of the earth should be satisfied with the name he earns and the umbrella (held over his head as a sign of royalty) and should divided the wealth among his servants and not be the sole possessor of everything.

sa: यदा स सेनापतिरप्रमेयः परामृद्नन्निषुभिर्धार्तराष्ट्रान्। द्रोणं रणे शत्रुसहोऽभियाता तदा युद्धं धार्तराष्ट्रोऽन्वतप्स्यत्॥
en: When that leader of armies, of immeasurable strength, working havoc among the armies of the sons of Dhritarashtra by his arrows, goes forth to encounter Drona and the enemy in battle; then will the son of Dhritarashtra repent for the war.

sa: देवा ऊचुः नहुषेणाभितप्तानां त्वं लोकानां गतिः पुरा। भ्रंशितश्च सुरैश्वार्यात् स्वर्लोकाल्लोककण्टकः॥
en: The celestials said: You became in the days of yore the refuge of creatures when they were oppressed by Nahusha. Deprived of his heaven's affluence, he was thrown down, a thorn of the heaven as he was, from the celestials region.

sa: अथोपविष्टः प्रतिसत्कृतश्च वृद्धेन राज्ञा कुरुसत्तमेन। प्रचोदित: संकथयाम्बभूव धर्मानिलेन्द्रप्रभवान् यमौ च॥
en: Having been received with all respect by that foremost of the Kurus, that old king (Dhritarashtra) the Brahmanas took his seat; and then asked by the king, he talked about the son of Dharma, Pavana, Indra and the twins (Asvinis). son

sa: ब्राह्मणा एव वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च बहुदक्षिणाः। अन्योन्यं विभवाचारा यजन्ते गुणतः सदा॥
en: The Brahmanas represent the Vedas themselves and all the sacrifices with profuse presents. Desirous of excelling one another, they always celebrate sacrifices, actuated by their various desires. The king should, therefore, make presents of various sorts of valuable wealth to them.

sa: तस्मान्मौनेन मुनयो दीक्षां कुर्वन्ति चादृताः। दुरुक्तस्य भयाद् नाभाषन्ते च किंचन॥
en: It is for this reason that ascetics adopt the vow of silence, and, honoured by all, pass through initiation without speaking a single word, For fear of saying what is incorrect or what may offend, ascetics never utter a single word.

sa: दत्वा गाश्चैव विप्रेभ्यः पूतात्माऽभवदात्मवान्। तमेव चाश्रमं गत्वा चचार विपुलं तपः॥
en: Making gifts of kine to persons of the twiceborn order, his soul became purified and he succeeded in gaining a knowledge of it. Going to that very asylum where he had lived in his former birth, he practised very severe penances.
